jobs.title: Emergency Services & Security Manager
jobs.location: Fort Mill, South Carolina, United States
jobs.description:
Summary of Position

The Emergency Services and Security Manager leads the facility's emergency preparedness, emergency response, and security programs to protect the community, environment, plant personnel, assets, and operations. This role oversees the Emergency Response Team (ERT), ensures compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, and maintains readiness to respond to hazardous material incidents, fires, medical emergencies, security threats, and other crisis situations. The position works closely with site leadership and external agencies to promote a safe, secure, and resilient manufacturing environment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Lead and manage the facility Emergency Response Team (ERT) in compliance with applicable OSHA and EPA requirements.
• Develop, implement, and maintain emergency response plans, procedures, and preparedness programs.
• Ensure readiness for hazardous material incidents, fires, medical emergencies, confined space rescues, severe weather events, utility disruptions, and other plant emergencies.
• Maintain emergency response equipment, vehicles, PPE, and specialized response resources.
• Organize and conduct emergency drills, exercises, tabletop scenarios, and response evaluations.
• Coordinate emergency preparedness activities with local fire departments, law enforcement, emergency medical services, emergency management agencies, and mutual aid partners.
• Serve as Incident Commander or other designated Incident Command System (ICS) position during emergency events.
• Ensure ERT members maintain required qualifications, certifications, and competencies.
• Develop and deliver emergency response, security awareness, and crisis management training.
• Provide technical guidance and leadership during drills, exercises, and emergency events.
• Mentor ERT members and support succession planning for emergency response leadership roles.
• Promote a culture of emergency preparedness, security awareness, and operational excellence throughout the facility.
• Develop and administer physical security, access control, visitor management, and workplace violence prevention programs.
• Oversee contract security personnel and security service providers.
• Conduct security assessments and implement measures to protect personnel, assets, information, and operations.
• Manage response procedures for bomb threats, suspicious packages, unauthorized access, active threats, and other security incidents.
• Investigate security incidents and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
• Support site business continuity, crisis management, and disaster recovery planning efforts.
• Coordinate emergency communications and stakeholder notifications during incidents.
• Lead post-incident critiques, after-action reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Assist site leadership in emergency planning and risk mitigation strategies.

Skills

• Thorough knowledge of OSHA and EPA emergency response requirements.
• Strong understanding of Incident Command System (ICS) and emergency management principles.
• Knowledge of hazardous materials response, industrial firefighting, emergency medical response, and rescue operations.
• Understanding of industrial security, access control systems, surveillance systems, and workplace violence prevention.
• Knowledge of Process Safety Management (PSM) and Risk Management Program (RMP) principles.
• Strong investigation, problem-solving, and root cause analysis skills.
• Effective verbal and written communication skills.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities during both routine operations and emergency situations.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and emergency management software systems.
• Strong project management and organizational skills.

Traits

• Strong leadership presence with the ability to direct emergency operations.
• Calm and composed and able to exercise sound judgement in high stress situations.
• Proactive and detail oriented.
• Critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
• Adaptability to adjust safety strategies to meet changing organizational needs and industry trends.
• Strong commitment to employee safety, security, and environmental stewardship.

Physical Requirements

• Ability to walk manufacturing floors for extended periods.
• Ability to climb ladders and work around production equipment.
• Lift up to 40 pounds occasionally.
• Wear required PPE including safety glasses, steel-toe footwear, hearing protection, and respiratory protection when required.

Education / Qualifications / or Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Emergency Management, Fire Science, Occupational Safety, Environmental Science, Criminal Justice, Industrial Technology, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
• Seven (7) or more years of industrial emergency services, fire brigade, hazardous materials response, or security management experience.
• Experience managing emergency preparedness and response programs in a manufacturing, chemical, energy, mining, battery, or other industrial environment.
• Experience leading emergency incidents and coordinating with external emergency response agencies.
• Working knowledge of OSHA emergency response requirements and applicable regulatory standards.
• Previous supervisory or management experience.
• Experience supporting OSHA Process Safety Management (PSM) or EPA Risk Management Program (RMP) regulated facilities.
• Strong communication, leadership, and organizational skills.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office and safety management software.

Preferred Certifications

• Hazardous Materials Incident Commander
• Fire Officer or Fire Instructor certifications
• EMT, Advanced EMT, or Paramedic certification
• Certified Emergency Manager (CEM)
• Certified Protection Professional (CPP)
• Certified Hazardous Materials Manager (CHMM)
• Board of Certified Safety Professionals Certified Safety Professional (CSP)

• OSHA 30-Hour General Industry

Compensation and Benefits

jobs.title: Principal Staff Software Engineer - Compute Infrastructure
jobs.description:
This role will be based in Mountain View, CA

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

As a Principal Staff Software Engineer of the Compute Infrastructure team at LinkedIn, you will play a crucial role in our ongoing efforts to re-architect our compute infrastructure stack. This is a high-profile, high-impact project that touches every aspect of our engineering organization. We are looking for professionals who have a proven track record of designing large-scale compute infrastructure and driving consensus.

In this role, you will design and implement solutions that enable LinkedIn to scale its compute infrastructure to meet the demands of a rapidly growing user base. This will involve working closely with a team of engineers to develop and operate solutions that are robust, scalable, and efficient. You will also need to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and be comfortable operating in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

If you are passionate about building the underlying technology that powers one of the world's most-used internet applications, and have the skills and experience to help us take our compute infrastructure to the next level, we want to hear from you. Apply now to join our team and help shape the future of LinkedIn.

Responsibilities:

• Define the multi-year technical vision for LinkedIn's compute platform, translating company-level priorities into an infrastructure architecture and roadmap.
• You will build and operate world class high performance scheduling/deployment solutions including some of the world's largest Kubernetes clusters to place stateless/stateful services, ML workloads and short running jobs efficiently.
• You will build and operate a platform that allocates hardware resources with necessary physical/logical distribution for fault tolerance and easy maintenance.
• Build alignment across the engineering organization on infrastructure direction, partnering with distinguished engineers, fellows, and senior leadership
• Elevate engineering quality org-wide by coaching senior engineers, setting technical standards, and shaping how infrastructure decisions are made at LinkedIn

Basic Qualifications

• BS/BA in Computer Science or related technical field or equivalent technical experience
• 10+ years of industry experience in software design, development, and algorithm related solutions
• 10+ years of experience programming in object-oriented languages such as Java, Go, C/C++, Rust, Rust, Python
• Experience developing large-scale distributed systems
• 4+ years of experience as an architect, or technical leadership position
• Experience developing large-scale distributed systems and using agentic software engineering

Preferred Qualifications

• 15+ years of experience in software design, development, and algorithm related solutions
• 15+ years of programming experience in an object-oriented programming language such as Go, Java, C/C++, Rust
• 5+ years of experience in a technical leadership position
• 5+ years of experience building large-scale compute infrastructure, and distributed systems
• Demonstrated understanding of operating system fundamentals, container technologies, and systems knowledge.
• Experience building and operating cluster management solutions such as Kubernetes.
• Experience with IaaS systems and capacity management.
• Experience with networking and security principles.
• Experience in leading technical teams and mentoring other engineers

Suggested Skills

• Distributed Systems
• Kubernetes
• Golang
• Technical Leadership

jobs.description:
Job Title:             Director of Accounting/Controller

Department:       Accounting

Reports To:        SVP – CFO

Salary Range:    $130,000 - $175,000/yr

POSTION SUMMARY: The Director of Accounting and Financial Reporting (“Director”) position at HomeXpress Mortgage (“Company”) is a senior level management position. The Director/Controller is responsible for the Company’s:

• Accounting and tax department functions.
• All GAAP, external and internal management reporting.
• Oversight of the Company’s external audit process and coordination of all tax compliance and planning.
• Implementation of a functioning effective and efficient internal control framework.
• Assist with and/or perform financial forecasting and budgeting for the Company.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Manage and lead the Company’s accounting operations and personnel.
• Develop, document, and maintain accounting position policies in accordance with GAAP.
• Ensure that the accounting operations are functioning at a high standard and that there is transparency in the financial results and the presentation thereof. Such results are to be concise and relevant.
• Maintain an effective accounting framework where all transactions are timely and accurately posted, with sufficient reconciliation and documentation.
• Structure an effective and efficient internal control framework and ensure the implementation of such, as well as the appropriate maintenance, testing and remediation of any deficiencies.
• Responsible for the accurate and timely monthly, quarterly, and year-end financial information and presentation, including the analysis of key performance indicators.
• Design and develop accounting system improvements, including system integrations to enhance workflow.
• Collaborates with other Company employees to achieve the Company’s financial goals and objectives. Monitor the Company’s financial performance on a pro-active basis.
• Work with external audit and tax personnel to be proactive as to the timely completion of GAAP audits, as well as accomplishing tax planning and compliance.
• Lead the development and implementation of new procedures and features to enhance the workflow of the accounting and tax activities.
• Develop meaningful data analytics and accounting metrics for management to assess the financial operations of the Company.
• Assist and/or lead the financial budgeting and planning processes, including the clear communication of such to Company leadership.
• Monitor and implement new GAAP standards and provide assessments of such to management.
• Identify and analyze potential risks and opportunities in the Company’s accounting operations.
• Mentor, develop and manage the accounting operations staff.

JOB REQUIREMENTS:

• Experience and working knowledge of GAAP and accounting in general as well as for mortgage banking activities including fair value and derivatives.
• Seven plus years of mortgage banking (or similar) industry experience.
• CPA license required.
• Proactive, detail-oriented, and solutions-oriented nature.
• People-oriented with a demonstrated inclination for service excellence.
• Demonstrated strong communication abilities.
• Proficiency with the Microsoft Office suite of products, including PowerPoint, as well as various accounting applications and platforms.
• Organized and able to create and effectively manage multiple timelines and schedules.

DESIRED PERSONAL CHARACTERISTICS:

• Self-Starter with positive “Can-Do” attitude.
• Able to handle sensitive information on a confidential basis.
• Works well under pressure and relishes the responsibility that comes with the position.
• Able to be a problem solver with the ability to communicate well both externally and internally.
• An open-minded individual that embraces change and innovation.

EDUCATION:

• Minimum of a bachelor’s degree in accounting or related business degree with accounting requirements.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

• This position is in an office setting with computer and general office equipment. The position requires the ability to move freely around within the department and other department locations.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

You will assist in the ongoing improvement of continuous integration tools, environment provisioning, and development workflows. You will ensure that we have appropriate levels of monitoring and alerting set up for all our applications across our mix of physical servers, private and public cloud.

Specific responsibilities as DevOps Engineer include:

• Build strong relationships across development and operations teams to understand the code, its dependencies, and the infrastructure on which it runs.
• Build and maintain systems that will monitor all aspects of the application and the infrastructure.

jobs.title: Associate, Industrial Tenant Representation
jobs.description:
Stream Realty Partners is investing in the continued growth of its Industrial brokerage platform in Atlanta, and we are seeking an Associate with existing commercial real estate experience to join our Industrial team. The role is primarily oriented toward tenant representation, with meaningful exposure across all industrial brokerage service lines, including landlord leasing, acquisitions, and investment sales.

This is a business development role at its core. The successful candidate will prospect actively, cultivate relationships with industrial occupiers throughout metro Atlanta, and take ownership of transactions from initial pursuit through closing. Stream pairs the resources of a national platform — more than 1,550 professionals and $11.5B+ in annual transaction volume — with the autonomy of a growing local team and proprietary research tools that provide a distinct information advantage at the submarket level. This position is well suited to a candidate who has established a foundation in commercial real estate and is prepared to assume greater territory and responsibility. This role offers strong earning potential through a performance-driven commission structure. Compensation may include a combination of base salary/draw, commissions/fees, and incentive opportunities. Actual earnings will vary based on individual performance.

Primary Responsibilities:

• Prospecting and cold calling industrial occupiers, owners, and decision-makers across metro Atlanta to generate new tenant representation and leasing opportunities
• Owning and growing a pipeline of active and prospective clients through consistent outreach, face-to-face meetings, and relationship development
• Building recognized expertise in Atlanta industrial submarkets and serving as a credible resource for occupiers, owners, and brokers active in those markets
• Running the full transaction cycle — market research and property identification, space surveys, tour coordination, RFP preparation and proposal analysis, financial modeling and lease comparisons, negotiation, and closing
• Tracking market-level data, comps, and availability to inform client advisory and sharpen competitive positioning
• Contributing to landlord leasing assignments and investment sales pursuits as opportunities arise across Stream’s industrial portfolio
• Preparing client presentations, market surveys, and deliverables that reflect Stream’s standard of quality and attention to detail
• Performing financial modeling and analysis to support tenant advisory, lease comparisons, and investment underwriting

• Bachelor’s degree required
• 2–5 years of commercial real estate experience, ideally in industrial brokerage, agency leasing, tenant representation, or a research or analyst seat supporting a production team
• Demonstrated track record of sourcing, supporting, or closing transactions and meeting business development goals
• Entrepreneurial mindset and comfort with a commission-based compensation structure
• Strong prospecting instincts and the discipline to maintain a consistent outreach cadence independently
• Proficiency in Excel and comfort with financial analysis; experience with CoStar and CRM tools preferred
• Active Georgia real estate license, or ability to obtain one within 60 days of start date
• Working knowledge of metro Atlanta industrial submarkets and the ability to speak credibly to occupiers and owners about market conditions
• Self-starter mentality with the ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative team environment
• Competitive drive and a genuine desire to build a long-term career in industrial brokerage
• Strong written and verbal communication skills

Shape the Future of Nursing Education

In this role, you’ll help shape the next generation of healthcare providers through high‑quality nursing education delivered in classroom and clinical settings. You’ll play a vital role in teaching, mentoring, evaluating, and supporting students while contributing to the broader academic and professional community in alignment with Chamberlain’s mission.

What You’ll Do

• Teach assigned nursing courses across classroom, online, clinical, lab, and simulation environments using engaging, evidence‑based, and technology‑enabled methods.
• Contribute to curriculum development and implement approved course content and teaching materials.
• Put students first—build meaningful relationships, understand individual needs, and foster an inclusive learning environment that supports success.
• Evaluate student performance and provide timely, constructive feedback and remediation as needed.

• Support student and new faculty success through guidance, coaching, and mentoring.

• Engage in scholarship related to teaching and nursing practice by researching, applying, and sharing new knowledge.
• Maintain subject‑matter expertise and teaching effectiveness through ongoing professional development.
• Apply and uphold academic and student‑related policies, including exams, attendance, and grading standards, staying current with updates.
• Perform other duties as assigned and comply with all policies and standards.

How You’ll Succeed

• Anticipate and respond to student needs while helping remove barriers to success.
• Align daily work with Chamberlain’s vision and strategic priorities.
• Seek feedback, implement new initiatives, and use data to continuously improve student outcomes.
• Collaborate effectively with internal and external partners in a matrixed environment.
• Demonstrate ethical practice, accountability, and a commitment to shared success.

What Success Looks Like

• Students achieve strong outcomes, including NCLEX, KAM, and other program metrics.
• High levels of student engagement and satisfaction reflected in evaluations and NPS feedback.
• All academic work meets licensure and regulatory requirements.
• Grading and feedback are accurate, rubric‑aligned, timely, and high quality.
• Effective use of technology, data, and AI tools to enhance teaching and learning.
• Ongoing faculty contributions to service, scholarship, and a positive academic culture aligned with Chamberlain’s values.

Required Qualifications

• Master’s degree in nursing.
• At least 2 years of professional experience in a field related to the teaching discipline.
• Active, unencumbered licensure or certification required to practice professionally in the discipline, as applicable to assignment.
• Education and experience that align with state, regulatory, and licensure requirements for assigned courses.
• Demonstrated ability to effectively teach assigned courses based on education, experience, and professional preparation.

Preferred Qualifications

• Doctorate degree in nursing.

Teaching & Professional Skills

• Excellent communication skills, sound judgment, and a high level of initiative.
• Proven ability to create engaging, inclusive learning environments and manage conflict effectively.
• Strong emotional and social intelligence, with the ability to recognize student needs and respond with empathy.
• Experience collaborating with faculty, Extended Service Teams, and clinical partners to support student outcomes.

Technology & Innovation

• Proficiency with learning management systems, simulation equipment, and online teaching platforms.
• Growing ability to leverage technology, data, and AI tools to enhance teaching and learning effectiveness.

Scholarship & Professional Development

Demonstrates scholarship appropriate to academic rank, including at least one example in one of the following areas:

• Scholarship of Discovery
• Scholarship of Integration
• Scholarship of Practice/Application
• Scholarship of Teaching and Learning
• Scholarship activities must be public, peer‑reviewable, and accessible for use by others, as outlined in the faculty handbook.

Compliance & Credentialing

• Maintains current regulatory, licensure, and practice credentials as required by assignment.
• For faculty working in clinical settings, meets all additional compliance requirements outlined in the Faculty Compliance Packet.
• Additional state‑specific requirements may apply; refer to the Online Faculty Licensure Requirements Document for details related to your designated specialty.

jobs.title: Field Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
Freshworks is looking for a Field Marketing Specialist to build the operational engine behind our regional event programs. Today, Field Marketing Managers (FMMs) own both the strategy and the execution of every event, from forecasting and business cases on one end to vendor contracts and lead uploads on the other. That’s a lot of ground for one person to cover, and it means our best strategic thinkers spend too much time in the weeds.

This role is the fix: a shared execution engine that lets FMMs focus on strategy, stakeholder relationships, and pipeline impact, while you own flawless on-the-ground program delivery, from kickoff through post-event closeout. This isn’t a 1:1 hire per marketer, it’s a pooled model, so you’ll support multiple FMMs across a region and get exposure to a diverse portfolio of third-party conferences, executive experiences, customer events, partner programs, and regional activations. Priorities and assignments are managed centrally based on event complexity, timing, and regional need.

What You’ll Do

• Vendor Sourcing & Management: Find, vet, and manage the vendors that bring events to life.
• Contracts, POs & Budget Administration: Coordinate with Procurement, Legal, Finance, and vendors to move contracts and purchase orders forward, track approvals, and keep spend aligned to budget so FMMs don’t have to chase it.
• Program Logistics & Production: Own the shipping, swag, and promotional execution, the physical work that makes an event actually happen.
• Brand & Creative Coordination: Partner with Brand, Design, Content, and Web, in conjunction with the respective FMM, to manage event graphics, booth assets, promotional materials, registration pages, and production timelines.
• SFDC Campaign Operations: Own campaign setup, registration, lead uploads, routing, and communications, the operational backbone of every campaign.
• On-Site Event Execution: Be the steady hand running the show in the room when necessary, in support of FMMs.
• Budget Tracking & Reconciliation: Know where every dollar went and be able to say so.
• Reporting & Wrap Decks: Turn raw event data into a clean, digestible summary FMMs can hand to leadership.
• Process Improvement: Maintain templates, documentation, vendor resources, and repeatable event workflows that improve consistency and help the team scale.
• Travel: Manage assigned events on-site, supporting priority programs across the regional portfolio as needed.

• Relevant Experience: 2-4 years in event operations, field marketing, marketing operations, or a similar coordination-heavy role.
• Multitasking Under Load: Comfortable juggling multiple vendors, budgets, and deadlines at once without dropping a ball.
• Tool Fluency: Working knowledge of (or eagerness to learn) SFDC, Airtable, Cvent, and SplashThat.
• Detail Orientation: The kind of person who notices the swag order is short before it becomes a problem.
• Composure On-Site: Calm under pressure; events don’t run on a script.
• Strong Communication: Strong written communication for cross-functional coordination with Ops, Content, Digital, Web, and Brand.
• Service Mindset: A strong service mindset with the ability to manage expectations across multiple internal stakeholders.
• Independent Execution: Able to work independently while keeping program owners informed.
• Travel Flexibility: Able to travel approximately 25–40%, including occasional evenings and weekends, based on the event calendar.

Bonus Points

• Pooled Model Experience: Prior experience in a shared-services or pooled-support model.
• Enterprise B2B Exposure: Exposure to enterprise B2B field marketing or an ABM motion.
• Sales Partnership: Experience partnering with Sales on event outreach, lead follow-up, or campaign execution.
• Production Experience: Experience managing branded event assets, tradeshow booths, or promotional production.

Please note this is a hybrid role with onsite expectations of 3 days a week onsite (Tuesday - Thursday) at our San Mateo, CA headquarters.

We're committed to building a workplace that reflects the diverse world we serve. At Freshworks, you'll find inclusive teams, flexible thinking, and opportunities to grow your career - while making work better for millions.

If this sounds like a journey you want to be part of, we'd love to meet you. Let's building something refreshing together.

Compensation is based on a variety of factors including but not limited to location, experience, job-related skills, and level. Bonus/equity may be available.

jobs.title: Research Analyst and Scientific Communications Specialist
jobs.description:
About Novellia:



Novellia is the first and only company that lets anyone in the US gain access to nearly a decade of their health data in under 30 seconds, 100% free. All your health records, across doctors, all in one place, always up to date.



We work with the world's top researchers to safely turn health insights into life-changing action for millions of people across the world.

Novellia is the only patient-powered real world data platform delivering comprehensive, patient-authorized longitudinal health insights to accelerate biopharma innovation. Unlike traditional RWD providers who provide fragmented institutional data, we empower patients to access 15+ years of their health records for free, then transform these complete health journeys into fit-for-purpose datasets for evidence generation, regulatory submissions, and market access. We're growing 5x YoY with top pharma partners, our data have been published with leading scientific organizations such as ASCO and SABCS/AACR, and are backed by tier-1 investors including Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, Bling Capital, and more.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Novellia is seeking a technically sharp analyst with 3-5 years of experience to work with our patient data and translate findings into compelling scientific communications. You will run analyses on Novellia's datasets with support from our solutions team and turn those insights into content for media, marketing, and public-facing audiences. This is a hands-on data role with a strong communications component.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Conduct quantitative analyses on Novellia's patient datasets, working closely with the solutions team for guidance and methodology support

 - Harmonize and manipulate data across multiple sources and formats to support research questions

 - Translate analytical findings into scientific communications materials including white papers, abstracts, media summaries, and marketing content

 - Develop accessible, accurate summaries of complex findings for non-specialist audiences including journalists, patients, and partners

 - Support press and media outreach related to Novellia's research and data assets

 - Maintain rigorous standards for data integrity and ethical use of patient data


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 3-5 years of experience in a data-intensive role within healthcare, life sciences, or a related field

 - Strong technical skills in data analysis and manipulation, including proficiency in R and Python

 - Advanced proficiency in using AI tools to support and accelerate biostatistical analysis, including AI-assisted coding workflows

 - Experience harmonizing large, complex datasets across multiple sources and formats

 - Excellent scientific writing skills with the ability to communicate findings clearly to non-specialist audiences

 - Familiarity with real-world data, patient registries, or observational research is a strong plus

 - Comfortable working with guidance from a technical team and taking direction on analytical approach



Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Novellia, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

U.S. Applicants Only

jobs.title: Respiratory Clinical Specialist, Full-Time, Days
jobs.description:
The Respiratory Clinical Specialist reflects the mission, vision, and values of Northwestern Memorial, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Respiratory Clinical Specialist performs selected special procedures to patients that require complex respiratory intervention and monitoring.  Utilizes appropriate patient assessment and triaging practices and applies advanced clinical and technical skills.  Provides all modes of respiratory care and is certified to perform procedures over multiple service divisions.

Responsibilities:

• Performs all functions of a Respiratory Therapist – RRT; see job class #9417
• Implements special clinical procedures within one of the following specialty areas: ECMO; Asthma/COPD; Tracheostomies: Medical ICU; Coronary Care Unit and Cath Lab; Surgical ICU and PACU; Cardio-Thoracic ICU; Neuro-Spine ICU; Pulmonary Unit; Neonatal ICU; Trauma & Emergency Response; involving highly technical equipment management requiring understanding and functional knowledge of complex physiologic processes and interpretation of data.
• Consults with physicians, nurses and other health care professionals and participates in daily patient rounds for assigned specialty area to promote consistent quality and delivery of patient care.
• Administers respiratory therapy primarily within a defined specialty area, but is also proficient in multiple clinical specialty areas.
• Provides orientation, technical/clinical direction and guidance to staff upon hire and on an ongoing basis to ensure standards of high quality are achieved and maintained in the delivery of patient care and compliance with policies, procedures and clinical protocols.
• In the absence of the Clinical Coordinator or the Education Coordinator, effectively assumes his/her responsibilities to carry through the operations of the department.

Administration of Work

• Provides direct patient care for a minimum of 50% of hours worked; for direct patient care responsibilities, see job class # 9417
• Performs ongoing assessments of the patient service needs in the assigned specialty area.
• Presents minimum of 2 in-service programs per year for departmental staff.
• Assists Education Coordinator with annual departmental clinical competencies.
• Performs equipment evaluations and active research projects and provides follow-up to manager and Clinical Coordinator.
• Reviews and revises existing policy and procedure manuals.
• Develops policy and procedures for new equipment and procedures.
• Assists with the development of clinical research protocols and participates in their implementation.
• Oversees and coordinates ongoing clinical research projects and participates on selected patient care committees.

Leadership/Supervisory Skills:

• Oversees other therapists within the specialty areas in the performance of specific duties.
• Teaches specific clinical skills to staff/students and serves as a professional role model
• Provides orientation to staff/students and other health professionals to department, patient care floors and policies.
• Provides input to Performance Management for other staff
• Attends committee meetings within assigned specialty area and provides manager with updates of pertinent issues.

Communications/Relationships:

• Reports daily operational issues of the specialty area to the Respiratory Clinical Coordinator, ECMO Coordinator, or Education Coordinator, depending on specialty.
• Promotes and maintains open lines of communication with all departmental staff.
• Attends/contributes to monthly departmental and discipline specific meetings in addition to meetings for specialty.
• Serves as a liaison between the Department of Respiratory Care and the medical staff within specialty area to promote consistency.

Organizational Expectations

• Adheres to the Hospital and departmental policies and procedures.
• Adheres to the Code of Ethics, Customer Service Standards and the Patient’s First mission as demonstrated through positive patient/guest relations, positive and effective interactions with staff, formulating and meeting developmental goals.

Required:

• Registered Respiratory Therapist (RRT)- National Board of Respiratory Care Respiratory Care Practitioner (RCP)- Illinois Department of Professional Regulation.
• Basic Life Support- American Heart Association.
• Advanced Cardiac Life Support- American Heart Association.
• Pediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS) – American Heart Association (within one year of promotion or hire for all specialties except neonatal ICU).
• Neonatal Resuscitation Program (NRP) – American Heart Association (for Neonatal ICU specialty
• Adult Critical Care Specialty (ACCS) – National Board of Respiratory Care (within one year of hire or promotion for all specialties except Neonatal ICU).
• Neonatal/ Pediatric Specialist (NPS)- National Board of Respiratory Care (within one year of hire or promotion for Neonatal ICU specialty).
• Extracorporeal Life Support Organization (ELSO) certification (within one year of hire or promotion for ECMO specialty).
• AE-C Certification (within one year of hire or promotion for the Asthma/COPD specialty)

• Minimum of 5 years of Critical Care Experience in a level one trauma and major academic medical center.

Preferred:

• Master’s Degree in Respiratory Therapy or Science.
• Registered Pulmonary Function Technologist (RPFT)- National Board of Respiratory Care.
• Sleep Disorders Specialty (SDS) – National Board of Respiratory Care.

jobs.title: Sales Executive, Midwest
jobs.description:
Why Pythian:

At Pythian, we are experts in strategic database and analytics services, driving digital transformation and operational excellence. Pythian, a multinational company, was founded in 1997 and started by ensuring the reliability and performance of mission-critical databases. We quickly earned a reputation for solving tough data challenges. We were there when the industry moved from on-premises to cloud environments, and as enterprises sought more from their data, we expanded our competencies to include advanced analytics.

Today, we empower organizations to embrace transformation and leverage advanced technologies, including AI, to stay competitive. We deliver innovative solutions that meet each client’s data goals and have built strong partnerships with Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, SAP, and Snowflake. The powerful combination of our extensive expertise in data and cloud and our ability to keep on top of the latest bleeding edge technologies make us the perfect partner to help mid and large-sized businesses transform to stay ahead in today’s rapidly changing digital economy.

Why you:

Pythian sits at the intersection of data engineering, AI production, and managed services — helping enterprises turn data complexity into competitive advantage. With three decades of deep managed services heritage and strategic partnerships across the leading cloud and database technology ecosystems, we are at the forefront of helping clients move from AI experimentation to AI in production.

We are looking for a polished, quota-carrying Sales Executive who is energized by the AI moment and knows how to help enterprise clients build the modern, well-managed data foundations that make production AI possible at scale. You are comfortable hunting new logos, converting inbound leads, and growing existing accounts. You bring credibility in conversations about Database Managed Services, Production AI, and cloud and database technologies — and you know how to co-sell effectively with OEM and hyperscaler partners to drive mutual value.

What Makes This Role Unique:

Pythian’s portfolio spans the full stack from data foundations to production AI — Production AI, Database Managed Services, AI Strategy & Automation, Data Migrations, Cloud Consulting, and Agentic AI solutions, supported by partnerships across Google Cloud, Oracle, AWS, Microsoft Azure, SAP, and the broader modern data ecosystem. This means you’re never selling a point solution; you’re building long-term, high-value partnerships with clients who want a trusted advisor to help them scale intelligently.

If you’re energized by the AI transformation happening across enterprise technology right now, know how to sell complex managed services, and want to represent a company with deep technical credibility and a growing AI practice — this role is built for you.

What you will be doing:

Territory & Pipeline

• Build and execute a territory plan with a disciplined mix of new logo hunting, inbound conversion, and account expansion.
• Maintain a robust, accurately forecasted pipeline in Salesforce; provide weekly pipeline reviews and revenue projections.
• Develop targeted account strategies for key prospects in retail, manufacturing, logistics, financial services, and other enterprise verticals.
• Identify and pursue net-new logos while deepening relationships and expanding wallet share within existing accounts.

AI & Data Services Sales

• Lead discovery and solution conversations around Production AI, AI Strategy, Agentic AI, and AI Automation with enterprise buyers (CAIO, CDO, CTO, CIO).
• Articulate how modern, well-managed data estates — across databases, cloud data platforms, and data migrations — are the critical scaffolding for scalable AI.
• Sell the business case for Database Managed Services and DBA Support, connecting operational reliability to AI readiness and cost efficiency.
• Help clients understand Pythian’s phased “Data Foundations to Production AI” journey and position appropriate entry points based on their maturity.

Partner & OEM Co-sell

• Co-sell with hyperscaler and OEM field teams — including Google Cloud, Oracle — to drive joint pipeline and leverage partner co-sell programs, Marketplace motions, and funded assessment opportunities.
• Navigate partner deal registration, funding programs, and co-sell qualification processes across multiple technology ecosystems to accelerate deal velocity and protect margin.
• Build and maintain strong field relationships with partner account teams, knowing how to activate the right partner resources at the right stage of a deal.
• Serve as the primary relationship owner for your accounts while leveraging Pythian’s delivery, solutions, and field CTO resources as needed.

Deal Execution & Internal Orchestration

• Lead enterprise sales cycles end-to-end: discovery, business case development, proposal, negotiation, and close.
• Act as the internal project manager for your deals — coordinating across Solutions Architecture, Delivery, Legal, and Finance to keep complex cycles moving, ensure scope integrity, and deliver proposals on time.
• Know when and how to engage the right internal resources (Field CTO, practice leads, delivery SMEs) and manage those relationships to build credibility with prospects without over-committing delivery capacity.
• Prepare and present compelling proposals, RFP responses, and executive-level business case materials.
• Document client interactions, capture competitive intelligence, and share win/loss insights to continuously improve Pythian’s go-to-market.

Travel as required to attend client meetings, partner events, industry conferences, and Pythian’s annual sales kickoff.

What we need from you:

• 6+ years of enterprise technology sales experience with a consistent record of meeting or exceeding quota.
• Active experience selling Data & AI services — managed databases, cloud data platforms, AI strategy, or production AI implementations — to enterprise buyers.
• Demonstrated ability to sell managed services: you know who to call, how to build the business case, and how to navigate procurement for recurring-revenue engagements.
• Experience co-selling with hyperscaler or OEM field teams (Google Cloud, Oracle, AWS, Microsoft, or similar), including familiarity with partner programs, deal registration, and funded motions.
• Strong internal project management instincts: proven ability to orchestrate cross-functional resources — solutions architects, delivery leads, legal, finance — across complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles without losing momentum or scope control.
• A hunter’s instinct for new logos combined with the relationship acumen to grow and retain existing accounts.
• Polished enterprise presence with the ability to engage confidently at VP and C-suite level across business and technical audiences.
• Proficiency in Salesforce for pipeline management, forecasting, and account planning.

Strongly Preferred

• Experience selling within one or more of Pythian’s core technology ecosystems: Google Cloud (BigQuery, Vertex AI, Gemini) and/or Oracle (database, infrastructure), and also AWS, Microsoft Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, or SAP.
• Familiarity with the modern data stack and cloud data platforms across multiple hyperscalers.
• Comfort positioning AI solutions — Agentic AI, GenAI/RAG, MLOps, AI automation — to enterprise decision-makers.
• Experience with Database Managed Services or Infrastructure Managed Services sales cycles and pricing models.
• Background selling into $300M–$1B revenue companies in manufacturing, retail, logistics, finance, or healthcare verticals.
• Relevant cloud, database, or AI certifications are a plus.

Core Competencies

• Strategic territory planning and disciplined pipeline management.
• Consultative selling — ability to diagnose business problems before proposing solutions.
• Influence, persuasion, and consensus-building across complex enterprise buying committees.
• Continuous learning mindset — genuinely curious about AI developments and their enterprise implications.
• Clear, compelling written and verbal communication; strong presentation and proposal skills.
• Relevant Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of experience and education.

What you will receive:

• Love your career: Competitive total rewards package. Blog during work hours; take a day off and volunteer for your favorite charity.
• Love your work/life balance: Flexibly work remotely from your home, there’s no daily travel requirement to an office! All you need is a stable internet connection.
• Love your coworkers: Collaborate with some of the best and brightest in the industry!
• Love your development: Hone your skills or learn new ones with our substantial training allowance; participate in professional development days, attend training, become certified, whatever you like!
• Love your workspace: We give you all the equipment you need to work from home including a laptop with your choice of OS, and an annual budget to personalize your work environment!
• Love yourself: Pythian cares about the health and well-being of our team. You will have an annual wellness budget to make yourself a priority (use it on gym memberships, massages, fitness and more). Additionally, you will receive a generous amount of paid vacation and sick days, as well as a day off to volunteer for your favorite charity.

Hiring Disclaimer

• The successful applicant will need to fulfill the requirements necessary to obtain a background check.
• Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in any aspect of the selection process.

AI Disclaimer

Pythian may utilize Enterprise Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools or features throughout its hiring process. These tools help us manage high volumes of applications efficiently and may be employed to review applications, analyze resumes, and assist with other recruitment steps.  While Pythian uses AI in its hiring process, it does not substitute for human judgment. Our Talent Acquisition Team reviews all AI-generated recommendations, and the system is subject to regular bias audits to ensure fairness and compliance with all applicable employment and human rights laws. All final hiring decisions are made by, and remain the responsibility of, human decision-makers. By applying for this position, you consent to Pythian’s use of these AI tools in the evaluation of your application. You have the right to request a human review of any solely AI-driven decision or to request an accommodation. Should you require further details regarding the processing of your data, please reach out to us.

Outside Sales | Account Executive – SumUp

Location: El Paso, TX

Start Date is October 15th, 2026

About the team

SumUp's field sales team is on the ground, expanding into new markets across the country building real relationships with the small and medium size businesses that make up the heartbeat of local communities across the US. This team doesn't sell from behind a desk — they're out in the field, helping merchants discover tools that genuinely change how they run their businesses. As a Field Sales Representative, you'll own your territory, manage a full sales cycle, and be the face of SumUp for the merchants you serve. If you're driven by results, care about the people you work with, and want uncapped earning potential with a clear path to grow, this is the role for you.

What you'll do

• Build and manage a territory-based sales pipeline by prospecting, canvassing, and developing relationships with local businesses

• Run the full sales cycle from cold outreach and door-to-door canvassing through to close

• Research your territory to work smarter, identify the right opportunities, and prioritise your time effectively

• Use our CRM to track activity, manage your pipeline, and keep communication sharp

• Represent SumUp's payment and loyalty solutions in a way that genuinely helps merchants grow

You'll be great if the following describes you…

• Experience in sales, whether in retail, hospitality, B2B, or SaaS — we care more about your drive than your exact background or tenure in sales

• Comfort working independently in a field-based, territory-driven environment

• Strong ability to connect with people quickly, listen and tailor your approach to each merchants needs

• Reliable access to transportation to cover your assigned territory

• A track record of being self-motivated, resilient, and hungry to grow — even if you're still early in your career

Why you should join SumUp

🌍 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, in a remote-first field role across the US

🏖️ Generous time off: 22 days of paid vacation, plus an extra day each year up to 28 days, public holidays, quarterly Wellness Days, and special leaves

🏥 Health and life coverage: medical coverage via Cigna, plus life insurance

💼 Financial security: 401(k) retirement scheme with SumUp matching

🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service

Compensation

💰 On-target earnings of USD 107,000 ($50,000 base salary) with uncapped commission — the harder you work, the more you earn

📈 Clear opportunities for advancement and increased compensation based on performance

About SumUp

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 38 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 4,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.

SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited. Discover more about our culture and opportunities on our careers website, and follow our journey on LinkedIn, Instagram, and TikTok.

#SumUpUSA

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don’t tick every box, it’s ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

jobs.title: Emergency Veterinary Assistant - Oklahoma City, OK
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

VEG is a rapidly growing emergency company with hospital locations across the United States. Our mission is helping people and their pets when they need it most. We are revolutionizing emergency medicine with a “customer first” mentality and a true, employee-centric work environment.

TALENT + CULTURE AT VEG

At VEG, we want people and their pets to feel safe, secure, and valued; we want our employees to feel the same way. What we’re aiming to achieve on the customer side is equivalent in nature to what we want for our employees: to have the best experience possible. With the highest NPS score in our industry, we’re ready to ensure that VEG remains the place where the best and brightest in the emergency world not only want to work, but stay and grow. For our customers and their pets, we strive to find a way to say, “yes.” We do the same and more for our teams. In fact, VEG is one of this year’s nominees for INC Magazine’s Best Places to Work!

WHO WE NEED

You are passionate and motivated. You value learning and are a team player that is honest and respectful to your peers. You love what you do. You love working with animals and people. You are comfortable adapting to new scenarios, willing to learn new techniques, and think outside the box. You have excellent interpersonal capabilities across a diverse group. You’re happy to pitch in wherever and whenever you are needed, with a positive attitude. You demonstrate the ability to accomplish assigned tasks for all areas involved, knowing when to ask for assistance. You display excellent communication skills with your peers, customers, and team.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT TO DO

• Treat each patient and customer with the highest level of compassion and care.

• Perform basic to intermediate nursing care tasks, patient monitoring, and treatments.

• Use understanding of common diseases and conditions, physical assessment, and monitoring parameters to accurately triage incoming patients.

• Administer subcutaneous, intramuscular, and intravenous medications and understand potential adverse effects of medications.

• Set-up, monitor, and administer intravenous fluid therapy including constant rate infusions and blood transfusion therapy.

• Contribute as a team member to incoming outpatient care and ongoing inpatient care.

• Participate in giving and receiving patient rounds to ensure continuity of care.

• Be trained to properly perform all aspects of CPR as a RECOVER Certified Rescuer.

• Collect samples and perform diagnostic tests including in-house and point-of-care tests and diagnostic imaging.

• Assist in setting-up, performing, monitoring sedation and surgical anesthesia with LVT or DVM supervision.

• Perform nursing care tasks such as placing and maintaining urinary catheters and nasal oxygen tubes, and

• Set up, maintain, and troubleshoot oxygen cages and other oxygen administration techniques.

• Work alongside licensed veterinary technicians as a vital member of the nursing care team.

• Obtain additional training along guided growth pathways offering roles in addition to direct nursing care such as veterinary technician credentialing, trainer role, community outreach, and leadership.

Veterinary Assistants can additionally (where permitted by law):

• Administer, monitor, and maintain patients under general anesthesia with or without mechanical ventilation for patients with varied levels of risk.

• Perform advanced vascular access techniques including jugular catheter placement, sampling line placement, central line placement, intraosseous catheterization, and arterial catheterization.

• Perform advanced diagnostic techniques including ultrasonography and paracentesis,

• Participate in formulating treatment, anesthetic, and nursing care plans.

• Obtain additional training along guided growth pathways offering roles in addition to direct nursing care such as a trainer role, coordination of care, community outreach, and leadership.

WHY YOU SHOULD CHOOSE US

Because emergency is all we do, so we do it best! We also offer:

• Industry-leading‌ ‌compensation‌

• We build our hospitals from scratch. You’ll be using all of the latest equipment and technology.

• Generous employee pet discount

• Referral rewards - tell your friends why they should come work for VEG too!

• Health‌, Vision, and Dental ‌Insurance‌ ‌ ‌

• 401K‌ ‌w/‌ ‌company‌ ‌match‌ ‌ ‌

• Paid‌ ‌parental‌ ‌leave‌ ‌-‌ ‌up to 12 ‌weeks‌ ‌of‌ ‌paid‌ ‌leave‌ ‌at‌ ‌100%‌ ‌of‌ ‌regular‌ ‌salary‌ ‌

• Unlimited‌ ‌Continuing Education opportunities - we want to help you grow in your career!

• Flexible‌ ‌work‌ ‌schedules‌ ‌for‌ ‌a‌ ‌true‌ ‌work-life‌ ‌balance‌ ‌ ‌

• Growth‌ ‌potential‌ ‌ ‌

• Groceries‌ ‌sent‌ ‌to the hospitals weekly for the staff to enjoy,‌ ‌monthly‌ ‌and‌ ‌quarterly‌ ‌contests,‌ ‌quarterly‌ ‌hospital‌ ‌outings,‌ company-wide retreats,‌ ‌etc!‌ ‌

• Lastly, because while our work is serious, we believe that it should also be fun!

VEG celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. You've found the equal opportunity employer you are looking for. We can't wait to meet you!

jobs.title: Founding Product Designer
jobs.description:
About Obviant

The defense market is surging, but the data that drives it hasn’t kept up. Companies, government, and investors are forced to perform heavily manual processes and piece together hundreds of disparate sources to make decisions. Obviant is building a data source of truth and AI tools for defense acquisition to solve this. We fuse information from thousands of sources – structured + unstructured – to provide a cohesive picture of budget, programs, the organizations running them, and much more. Whether it’s a company navigating GTM or a program manager developing capabilities, we’re providing all sides with the intelligence they need to execute effectively.

We’re growing fast and backed by top funds and DoD/national security veterans.

We believe that public sector mission sets matter above anything else. If you feel the same way, we’d love for you to join us.



The Role

We’re looking for a Founding Product Designer to be the foundation of our design efforts and own the end-to-end user experience across our products. As our first design hire, you’ll define our user experience strategy, lead design thinking, and execute all design and product initiatives as we bring cutting-edge technology to the defense sector. Working closely with product, engineering, and leadership, you’ll have the opportunity to shape both our user interface and our core identity in a fast-paced, mission-driven startup environment.

You’ll set the vision, move quickly, and iterate rapidly—ensuring our products are not only functional, but intuitive, engaging, and beautifully crafted. Depending on experience and performance, there is significant opportunity for you to grow into a leadership role with broader influence.

Responsibilities:

 - Define and lead the UX and UI strategy for our organization from the ground up, setting design vision and best practices.

 - Own end-to-end product design: from discovery and user research, to rapid prototyping, wireframes, visual design, and developer hand-off.

 - Collaborate closely with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to translate user needs and business goals into seamless, intuitive experiences.

 - Move quickly—generate and iterate on multiple design concepts to solve complex problems and inform product direction.

 - Create high-fidelity, production-ready UI and design assets for web-based and/or mobile applications.

 - Establish and contribute to a scalable design system and patterns library, ensuring consistency across our products.

 - Develop user journeys, interaction models, info architecture, and usability testing processes—which you’ll own and execute.

 - Champion a user-centered, data-informed design philosophy, leveraging user research and feedback to continually improve the product experience.

 - Set an example of design leadership and proactively identify areas for innovation in usability and aesthetics.

 - Stay current with the latest design trends, tools, and best practices, pushing boundaries to create delightful, meaningful user experiences.

 - Communicate your design decisions effectively, and inspire confidence and excitement about design at all levels of the organization.

Qualifications:

 - 5+ years’ experience in UI/UX design, interaction design, or product design roles (startup or high-growth environment highly preferred).

 - Strong, diverse design portfolio demonstrating your process and impact across shipped digital products.

 - Proven experience taking products from 0→1, including concepting, prototyping, designing, and iterating in fast-paced environments.

 - Expertise with modern design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Adobe products).

 - Demonstrated ability to generate and communicate multiple compelling design solutions to complex problems.

 - Excellent visual and written communication skills—you can clearly articulate and present your work to both technical and non-technical audiences.

 - Comfortable working autonomously, managing your own priorities, and proactively identifying areas where design can make the biggest impact.

 - Experience designing for enterprise, B2B SaaS, or defense/government markets a strong plus.

 - Familiarity with accessibility standards, responsive design, and usability best practices.

 - Passion for our mission: building better technology for defense, and willingness to immerse yourself in our users’ needs and challenges.

 - Ability to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI security clearance



Our Working Style – Why We Might Work Well Together

 - You care about government & are mission-oriented - Our work is important, and is critical to improving a system that impacts us all.

 - Perseverance and endurance - Hard problems are worth solving, and solving them can take a long time. There is no such thing as exhausting all options, it’s just time to look for new ones.

 - Empowerment > micro-management – We’re building a culture of high-performers. Our job is to equip them with what they need and eliminate roadblocks for them to succeed. We trust their judgment, skills, and experience from there.

 - We’re collaborative and communicate well - Constructive dialogue that takes all viewpoints into account is the only way we get to the right decision. Respect, trust, and complete transparency with each other is critical - keep it all in the open

 - You’re really good at what you do… but it speaks for itself – High output, no ego. Being humble is extremely important to us

 - You don’t mind change and are comfortable with uncertainty - We’re deliberate about setting goals, but we’re comfortable changing course and dealing with discomfort to get there. We’re still figuring things out, and that demands being flexible and iterative.

 - Work doesn’t feel like “work” to you – We’re passionate about what we’re going after, and we devote more time to it than a typical 9-5. That often means putting in extra time at night and occasionally on weekends. However, maintaining your own personal balance comes above all else, and you should establish that however you need to - flexible schedule, taking advantage of time off, or anything else you need.

 - You like to move fast and have a bias towards action - Our roadmap is directional at this stage - speed and a feeling of urgency is key to prove it out. We expect each other to proactively determine what needs to get done and go for it.

 - Integrity is never negotiable – Transparency, honesty, and respect comes above all else.

Benefits & Structure

 - We’re a tight-knit team headquartered in Arlington, VA. We work in the office together most days, and believe being in the same place is a competitive advantage.

 - Flexible schedule - We all have other things going on in our lives. Doctor visits, kids’ activities, dog walks - take care of it whenever you have to. And work from home when you need to.

 - Competitive compensation + Sizeable equity - We’re building something with massive upside potential, and you’ll have ownership in that. This is ours.

 - Flexible vacation time - Use what you want, as long as you’re taking care of what needs to get done.

 - Full health, dental, and vision insurance.

 - And more…

jobs.title: Client Success Manager, Labor & Multi Employer Funds
jobs.description:
Virta Health is on a mission to reverse metabolic disease in one billion people. Current treatment approaches aren’t working—over half of US adults have either type 2 diabetes or prediabetes, and obesity rates are at an all-time high. Virta is changing this by helping people reverse their metabolic condition through innovations in technology, personalized nutrition, and virtual care delivery reinvented from the ground up. We have raised over $350 million from top-tier investors and partner with the largest health plans, employers, and government organizations to help their employees and members restore their health and take back their lives. Join us on our mission to reverse metabolic disease in one billion people.

We are looking for a Customer Success Manager to join our Public Sector Customer Success team. In this role, you will serve as the strategic relationship manager for a portfolio of state, local government, education, and public-sector customers. You will partner with customer stakeholders to drive adoption, engagement, and measurable outcomes while navigating the unique complexities of public-sector organizations, including multiple stakeholders, procurement processes, and budget cycles. If you enjoy building trusted partnerships, solving complex challenges, and improving population health, we'd love to meet you.





RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Manage a portfolio of labor funds, unions, and multi-employer health plans.

 - Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for customer stakeholders.

 - Lead business reviews focused on engagement, outcomes, ROI, and long-term value.

 - Build relationships with fund administrators, consultants, trustees, and labor leadership.

 - Partner cross-functionally to solve customer challenges and drive successful outcomes.

 - Identify retention risks, growth opportunities, and strategies to strengthen partnerships.


90 DAY PLAN

Within your first 90 days at Virta, we expect you will do the following:

 - Develop a strong understanding of Virta's products, services, and customer success strategy.

 - Build relationships with key internal stakeholders and cross-functional teams.

 - Learn the unique dynamics of labor organizations and multi-employer funds.

 - Participate in customer meetings, trustee discussions, and business reviews.

 - Begin independently managing your assigned portfolio.




MUST-HAVES

 - 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Consulting, Healthcare, Benefits, or a related customer-facing role.

 - Strong relationship-building and communication skills.

 - Ability to manage multiple priorities while navigating complex customer environments.

 - Experience presenting outcomes, ROI, and strategic recommendations to leadership audiences.

 - Demonstrates a proactive use of AI tools to improve individual output and efficiency.


VALUES-DRIVEN CULTURE

Virta’s company values drive our culture, so you’ll do well if:

 - You put people first and take care of yourself, your peers, and our patients equally

 - You have a strong sense of ownership and take initiative while empowering others to do the same

 - You prioritize positive impact over busy work

 - You have no ego and understand that everyone has something to bring to the table regardless of experience

 - You appreciate transparency and promote trust and empowerment through open access of information

 - You are evidence-based and prioritize data and science over seniority or dogma

 - You take risks and rapidly iterate

Is this role not quite what you're looking for? Join our Talent Community https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/virtahealth/form/talent-community-form and follow us on Linkedin https://www.linkedin.com/company/virta-health to stay connected!

Virta has a location based compensation structure. Starting pay will be based on a number of factors and commensurate with qualifications & experience. For this role, the compensation range is $99,500-128,500/year.  Information about Virta’s benefits is on our Careers page at: https://www.virtahealth.com/careers.

As part of your duties at Virta, you may come in contact with sensitive patient information that is governed by HIPAA. Throughout your career at Virta, you will be expected to follow Virta's security and privacy procedures to ensure our patients' information remains strictly confidential. Security and privacy training will be provided.

As a remote-first company, our team is spread across various locations with office hubs in Denver and San Francisco. 

Clinical roles: We currently do not hire in the following states: AK, HI, RI

Corporate roles: We currently do not hire in the following states: AK, AR, DE, HI, ME, MS, NM, OK, SD, VT, WI.

Virta uses Ashby as its applicant tracking system, which incorporates AI-powered tools (provided by OpenAI, AWS, and Google Gemini) in certain aspects of the recruiting process, including application review, candidate screening, and interview note taking; your data is not used to train AI models, and all final hiring decisions are made by Virta Health personnel. For more information, see Ashby's AI Terms at https://www.ashbyhq.com/resources/terms-ai-features

jobs.title: Talent Partner (Sourcer)
jobs.description:
ABOUT READ AI:

Read AI builds AI that helps people understand and get more out of their meetings, emails, and messages — surfacing insights that used to require a human note-taker or analyst. We're growing fast, backed by leading investors, and scaling our team to match the pace of our product and customer traction.

As we head into a major growth year, we're doubling down on building the best team in the industry. This is starting with Engineering, which is set to nearly double in size over the next 12 months.




THE ROLE:

Read AI is looking for a Talent Partner (Sourcer) to build top-of-funnel for our hiring engine. This is an early-career role with real ownership: you'll proactively identify, engage, and nurture candidates for some of our highest-priority roles, working closely with our Head of Talent and hiring leaders across Engineering, Product, Design, and GTM.

You'll help build the sourcing and coordination processes that our growing Talent team runs on, not just execute against someone else's playbook. This role is designed as a launchpad: strong performance here puts you on a clear path toward a Recruiter role within 12–18 months.




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Sourcing & Pipeline Generation

 - Proactively identify and engage ~100 qualified candidates per week across LinkedIn Recruiter, Juicebox, and other channels

 - Build and manage strong, personalized outreach that converts passive candidates into active pipeline

 - Focus primary sourcing effort on Engineering roles, while flexing to support Product, Design, and GTM as needed

Process & Coordination

 - Help build and document repeatable sourcing and coordination processes as the Talent team scales

 - Support and help automate candidate and interview coordination to reduce manual overhead

 - Keep Ashby (or equivalent ATS) clean, current, and easy for recruiters and hiring managers to act on

Partnership & Representation

 - Build trusted relationships with hiring leaders across Engineering, Product, Design, and GTM to deeply understand hiring needs

 - Represent Read AI authentically in the broader talent community, building our reputation as a place top candidates want to work




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

 - Experience (internship, agency, or early in-house) in sourcing, recruiting coordination, or a related talent function

 - Comfort and curiosity with sourcing tools (LinkedIn Recruiter, Juicebox, or similar) and ATS platforms (Ashby or equivalent)

 - Strong written communication — able to write outreach that gets responses

 - A genuine interest in AI and how it's changing recruiting

 - High energy, coachability, and a growth mindset — eager to build toward a Recruiter role




NICE TO HAVE:

 - Prior sourcing experience specifically for Engineering or technical roles

 - Experience supporting a fast-growing startup environment

 - Familiarity with Ashby specifically

 - Existing presence or activity in talent/recruiting communities




WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS:

Every candidate this person finds and engages directly shapes who builds Read AI's product during our most important growth year yet. This isn't a support role, it's the front line of how Read AI wins great talent in a competitive market.




WHY READ AI?

 - Innovative: We bring AI to the masses with proactive technology that acts as the ultimate AI assistant, making individuals and teams more effective

 - Real impact, fast — Your work directly drives Engineering's growth during a pivotal year

 - A genuine growth path — Clear track to Recruiter within 12–18 months for strong performers

 - Hybrid, flexible culture — In-office Tuesday–Thursday, flexible PTO

 - A great team — Work alongside people who care about doing this well and supporting each other

Compensation range for this role is $80,000 - $90,000 plus equity. Actual total compensation will depend on the candidate’s qualifications, skills, and experience. We also offer low deductible health plans, as well as flexible time away and family leave programs.

Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Remilia is building a consumer social platform where the social graph, long-form content, real-time chat, and a virtual economy operate on a shared data model.

We're looking for software engineers who move fast and care about craft, and are interested in joining a small team with end-to-end ownership — you will build identity/auth, APIs, content systems, database architecture, client UI.

The engineering problems are interesting: graph queries on a relational database, real-time presence, content systems that outlive their feeds. Stack is intentionally boring technology, modular monolith: Go, SQLite, TypeScript/React.



You have:

 - A portfolio of interesting work

 - Experience shipping features end to end

 - Founding-engineer or 0→1 experience on small teams



Background or interest working in any of the following:

 - Real-time systems (WebSockets, fanout, presence)

 - Systems programming (C/C++/Rust)

 - Relational schema (data modeling, indexing, query design)

 - Media pipelines (upload, processing, delivery)

Us:

Benefits:

All roles in-office (Irvine, California).

To apply: include a portfolio of work.

jobs.description:
The AECOM Southwest Dams Department in Orange, California is seeking an experienced Geotechnical Team Lead with expertise in dams and levees to take on a leadership role within our geotechnical engineering practice.

This position provides the opportunity to lead and support major dam infrastructure projects, including dam safety evaluations, rehabilitation programs, and new dam design. The successful candidate will direct and support multidisciplinary teams working on various types of dams and related infrastructure such as spillways, outlet works, pump stations, and associated hydraulic structures.

The ideal candidate will bring strong technical expertise in geotechnical engineering for dams, experience leading engineering teams, and the ability to collaborate with a wide range of technical disciplines. This role also includes mentoring staff and supporting business development efforts with existing and new clients across the region.

Responsibilities for this position include, but are not limited to:

• Provide senior-level technical leadership and support to project teams on dam and levee projects including planning, design, inspection, construction observation, and regulatory compliance activities.
• Lead or support geotechnical design and analyses for dams, including slope stability, seepage, and seismic performance evaluations.
• Manage large multidisciplinary project teams and contribute to the successful delivery of complex dam infrastructure projects.
• Provide project management support or lead dam design and construction projects, including client coordination, contract management, planning, execution, and financial management, while serving in a Deputy Project Manager role on major projects.
• Oversee field exploration programs and characterization of soil and rock materials, including laboratory testing programs.
• Direct teams performing slope stability and seepage analyses and developing stabilization measures for dams, levees, spillways, and related infrastructure.
• Coordinate with teams performing hydrologic and hydraulic analyses, structural engineering, and civil design associated with dam and spillway projects.
• Support or lead dam construction oversight and field observation during rehabilitation or new construction activities.
• Perform and review seismic stability and deformation analyses of dams, including evaluation of earthquake ground motions, liquefaction potential, and earthquake-induced deformations.
• Oversee preparation of technical reports, independent dam safety inspections, and potential failure mode analyses (PFMA).
• Support business development efforts by identifying opportunities, strengthening relationships with dam and levee owners, and contributing to proposal preparation.
• Ensure quality and technical excellence of project deliverables through reviews and oversight.
• Mentor and support the technical development of junior and mid-level engineers.
• Perform Independent Technical Reviews (ITR) for dam-related projects.
• Serve as a local technical expert within a specialty area of geotechnical engineering for dams.
• Stay informed on industry developments, regulatory requirements, and best practices related to dam engineering and safety.
• Interpret, organize, and coordinate complex engineering assignments, making independent decisions on technical challenges and representing the organization in meetings and conferences with clients and regulatory agencies.
• Apply advanced engineering knowledge and experience to resolve complex technical challenges and unique project conditions.

Minimum Requirements

• BA/BS degree in Civil Engineering and 10+ years of relevant experience with dam projects including inspection, rehabilitation, and/or design and construction, or demonstrated equivalency of education and experience
• Professional Engineer (PE) license

Preferred Qualifications

• Master’s degree or PhD in Civil Engineering
• Established client relationships with dam and levee owners in California
• California Geotechnical Engineer (GE) license
• 20+ years of experience in geotechnical engineering related to dams and levees
• U.S. Citizenship
• Strong commitment to safe project execution and dam safety practices
