jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Security
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, Booking.com http://Booking.com, H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank. 

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.



As Imprint's Staff Engineer, Security, you'll own the security engineering foundation end to end — AI security governance, application security, cloud infrastructure, detection and response, and identity management. You'll report to the Director of Engineering for Trust & Security and operate as the technical lead defining how security is built at Imprint, using AI leverage from day one to scale impact well beyond headcount.

Imprint is deliberately small and talent dense. We use AI and tooling to give every person outsized leverage. This is a role where you stay hands on,  you set the strategic direction and do the work. Whether that balance shifts over time depends on what the business needs and what you want to build.

We power co-branded credit card programs for 10+ enterprise partners, with AI embedded across the business: underwriting, servicing, and how we build software. That AI leverage is core to how Imprint operates, and it creates a security challenge worth solving: how do you build an AI-forward security posture for an organization that moves this fast?




WHY THIS ROLE IS SPECIAL

 - Stay Hands On: Write detection rules, review PRs, file hardening commits, and threat model features alongside engineering teams. This isn't a role where you draw architecture diagrams and hand them off. You set the direction and ship the work yourself.

 - AI-Native Security: Build security capabilities using AI agents for detection triage, compliance automation, and dependency management. You'll secure AI products and use AI to multiply your own leverage. This is how one engineer operates at the standards of a company 10x this size.

 - Full Stack Ownership: Own the entire security domain: application security, cloud infrastructure, detection engineering, and AI governance. 

 - Preventative, Not Reactive: Build security that scales with the business rather than firefighting inherited problems. Do it right from the start, before bad patterns harden.

 - Series D Sweet Spot: We have product-market fit and real traction, but we're still small enough for you to shape everything. Your decisions will drive our security posture for years to come.

 - High Trust Domain: Co-branded credit cards in regulated fintech (PCI, SOC 2, ISO). Security isn't a tax here; it's what enables every partner launch and every customer interaction.


WHAT YOU WILL OWN

 - AI security: Threat-model Imprint's agent surfaces for prompt injection, tool misuse, and authorization boundaries.

 - AI for security: Build AI-native capabilities that scale your impact: AI-powered detection triage, automated compliance evidence collection, and threat modeling assistance.

 - Application security: Threat modeling for new features, secure code review, SAST/SCA/DAST in CI, SDL design, dependency management, and secrets management. You read Go and TypeScript well enough to review PRs and catch the bugs that external audits should not have to find.

 - Cloud and infrastructure security: IAM partitioning across multiple AWS accounts, least-privilege access, JIT elevation, cross-account trust hardening, KMS boundaries, SCP design, Kubernetes pod security, egress filtering, and Terraform security review.

 - Detection and response: Build the SIEM/SOAR pipeline from log sources through triage, write correlation rules, enable AI-powered triage, stand up on call rotation, and create incident response runbooks.

 - Identity and access: Drive SSO coverage, access reviews, and JIT elevation in partnership with IT.

 - Compliance partnership: Design and implement the controls that satisfy SOC 2, PCI, and ISO evidence requirements. GRC runs the audit cycle. You own the underlying controls and make sure they actually hold up, not just pass sampling.

 - Partner and customer trust: Lead technical responses to third party questionnaires and partner security reviews alongside GRC.


WHAT WE LOOK FOR

 - 8+ years in security engineering, with experience building a security function from early stages

 - Someone who builds and ships controls, not just identifies problems for others to fix

 - Reads and reviews code in production languages (Go, TypeScript, Python, or similar)

 - Detection engineering experience: has built a SIEM or SOAR pipeline from log sources through triage at least once

 - Deep AWS security knowledge: IAM policy design, multi account strategies, and how cloud privilege escalation works

 - Has operated inside PCI DSS scope and shipped controls that survived a real audit

 - Good judgment on scope: knows when to fix something directly versus set an SLA and hand it to the responsible team

 - Comfortable using AI tools to scale your own output while working within existing architecture and review processes


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience as the first or early security hire at a high-growth fintech or marketplace

 - Background at companies like Ramp, Mercury, Stripe, Whatnot, or similar fast scaling environments

 - Experience securing AI and ML systems, model pipelines, or AI-assisted development workflows

 - Familiarity with card issuing, payment processing, or financial services infrastructure

 - Terraform and Helm fluency with hands-on CI/CD security integration experience

 - Open source contributions, security research, or conference speaking
   
   

If you've built something real in security and want to do it again, we want to talk.




PERKS & BENEFITS

 - Competitive compensation and equity packages

 - Leading configured work computers of your choice

 - Flexible paid time off

 - Fully covered, high-quality healthcare, including fully covered dependent coverage

 - Additional health coverage includes access to One Medical and the  option to enroll in an FSA

 - 20 weeks of paid parental leave for the primary caregiver and 8 weeks for all new parents

 - Access to industry-leading technology across all of our business units, stemming from our philosophy that we should invest in resources for our team that foster innovation, optimization, and productivity
   
   

Imprint is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Imprint is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Imprint welcomes talented individuals from all backgrounds who want to build the future of payments and rewards. If you are passionate about FinTech and eager to grow, let’s move the world forward, together.

jobs.title: Manager, Support Engineering, US Government
jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. An overview of this role

As a Support Engineering Manager on our US Government support team, you’ll own the end-to-end delivery of world-class support for GitLab’s US Government customers. You’ll lead a tight-knit team of support engineers who troubleshoot complex environments and enterprise deployments, and you’ll evolve how we serve this highly regulated customer base so their experience not only meets but exceeds expectations. You’ll be responsible for hiring and developing excellent engineers, building and refining processes, and partnering closely with other Support Engineering Managers and product and engineering teams to ensure GitLab continues to meet the unique needs of government environments. You’ll also take part in our on-call rotation during working hours and join customer calls and ticket reviews when needed, giving you direct insight into customer challenges and the opportunity to shape how GitLab delivers secure, reliable support for critical government systems.

What you’ll do

• Lead a team of Support Engineers focused on troubleshooting complex environments for US Government customers and ensuring high-quality case resolution.

• Collaborate with other Support Engineering Managers to design, refine, and evolve our support model, processes, and tooling.

• Drive hiring efforts to build and grow a strong team, from sourcing and interviewing to onboarding and developing Support Engineers.

• Partner with product and engineering teams to share customer insights and influence how GitLab’s products and services evolve for government use cases.

• Participate in the manager on-call rotation during working hours to coordinate responses to escalated and critical customer situations.

• Support your team by joining customer calls, reviewing tickets, and providing hands-on guidance for complex or sensitive issues.

• Coach and mentor Support Engineers on technical troubleshooting, communication, and professional development, with a focus on customer-centered outcomes.

• Champion continuous improvement by identifying patterns in government customer needs and implementing changes that enhance our overall support experience.

What you’ll bring

• Experience leading and developing support engineering teams, including during periods of growth and change.

• Background managing technical support for complex enterprise products, ideally in environments with sensitive or regulated data.

• Familiarity with US Government customers and how their needs, processes, and constraints differ from private sector organizations.

• Ability to hire, onboard, and grow support engineers, with a focus on building balanced teams that can meet evolving customer needs.

• Skill in coaching and mentoring engineers through challenging customer issues, escalations, and professional development conversations.

• Experience handling crisis or high-severity incidents in production environments, including clear communication with internal teams and customers.

• Comfortable collaborating with cross-functional partners in engineering and product to advocate for customer needs and influence product direction.

• Openness to candidates with transferable leadership and support experience, even if their background is not exclusively in government-focused roles.

About the team

Our US Government Support team formed in 2019 and has grown alongside the adoption of GitLab within government agencies. We provide focused, high-quality technical support for US Government customers, helping them troubleshoot complex environments and use GitLab’s DevSecOps platform securely and effectively. We are distributed across the United States and balance synchronous and asynchronous collaboration to cover customer needs while working in a remote-first way. We are a mix of tenured and newer support engineers, and we are currently focused on scaling our processes, strengthening crisis management for sensitive systems, and deepening our partnerships with product and engineering teams to ensure GitLab continues to meet government-specific requirements.

Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it’s like to be a Geotabber, check out our blog and follow us @InsideGeotab on Instagram.

Who you are:

We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Head of Tax & Asset Compliance who will own the solution domain that helps North American fleets meet their tax and asset compliance obligations while protecting profitability. If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you!

What you'll do:

As a Head of Tax & Asset Compliance your key area of responsibility will be turning Geotab's telematics data into compliance outcomes (automated evidence, filings, and monitoring) that minimize compliance violations, fines, downtime, and administrative burden. You will need to work closely with the Tech Dev Board, Heads of Platform Domain, Heads of Segment Domain, peer Heads of Solution Domain, cross-functional domain teams (product managers, designers, product engineers), and external fleet customers.

To be successful in this role you will be a strategic leader with deep customer empathy, high adaptability, change readiness, and strong stakeholder management and communication skills. In addition, the successful candidate will have P&L literacy, commercial instinct, expertise in defining and tracking product KPIs, and the ability to operate at the intersection of business strategy, customer experience, and technical execution.

How you'll make an impact:

• Product Strategy & Vision: Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the domain, driving build/buy/partner decisions and evaluating emerging customer needs to strengthen market differentiation.

• Business & Metric Ownership: Accountable for primary business KPAs (e.g., submission success rates, violations avoided) and driving adoption of compliance workflows.

• Customer Value Delivery: Serve fleet operators, compliance managers, and asset owners as primary customers, defining and measuring experience metrics (adoption, time-to-value, NPS).

• Cross-Segment Alignment: Partner with Heads of Segment Domain to ensure tax and asset compliance capabilities are packaged and positioned effectively for key market segments.

• Feedback Loops & Experience Quality: Establish strong feedback loops with customers, sales, and support to resolve product gaps while owning UX quality standards across all domain surfaces.

• People Leadership & Coaching: Provide mentoring, career development, and performance management to cross-functional teams, identifying and coaching high-potential, next-generation leaders.

• Culture & Capacity Management: Foster a high-trust, high-accountability team culture focused on customer obsession and rapid iteration while managing team capacity across discovery and delivery.

• Financial Stewardship & Investment: Own the domain investment portfolio, leading annual planning for budget, headcount, and OKRs while balancing growth, quality, and capability bets.

• Executive & Board Reporting: Translate board-level direction into execution plans and regularly report on domain outcomes, revenue contributions, and delivery health to executive leadership.

• Cross-Domain & Platform Collaboration: Partner with Heads of Platform Domain to leverage shared infrastructure/APIs and coordinate with peer solution domains to eliminate duplication.

• Community & Strategic Leadership: Participate in practitioner communities (Engineering, Product, Design) and lead board-appointed, cross-functional initiatives across domains.

• Organizational Strategic Alignment: Support company-wide strategic initiatives, including AI workflow adoption, security posture, accessibility, and compliance programs

What you'll bring to this role:

• 10+ years of experience in product management, product engineering, or related customer-facing product roles.

• 5+ years of senior product and people leadership with cross-functional scope and direct accountability for customer-facing business outcomes.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent combination of education and work experience).

• Strong product leadership capability with demonstrated ability to define and execute customer-facing product strategy tied to measurable business outcomes, with P&L literacy and revenue attribution.

• Cross-functional leadership experience managing teams across product management, product design, and product engineering disciplines, with proven capability in identifying and coaching high-potential leaders.

• Excellent stakeholder management, change readiness, and communication skills to effectively collaborate with platform teams, segment leads, and executive leadership in evolving organizational structures.

• Familiarity with modern product discovery, validation practices, and engineering practices (CI/CD, cloud-native delivery, agile), alongside the ability to redesign domain workflows around AI to compress effort.

jobs.description:
Datadog is the monitoring and security platform for cloud applications. Our SaaS product is used by organizations of all sizes across a wide range of industries to enable digital transformation, cloud migration, and infrastructure monitoring of our customers’ entire technology stack, allowing for seamless collaboration and problem-solving among Dev, Ops and Security teams globally. Given the resilience of cloud technologies and importance placed today in digital operations and agility, Datadog continues to innovate and is well positioned for the long term.

Datadog’s Revenue Operations  & Finance team is in a phase of dynamic growth, committed to relentless enhancement and strategic problem-solving to drive business success. The Sales Revenue team at Datadog is instrumental in fueling our rapid growth trajectory. Collaborating seamlessly across various departments, we offer comprehensive commercial, operational, and analytical support to drive Datadog's business and Sales organization forward with unparalleled efficiency and agility. In this pivotal role, you will thrive within  an inclusive environment, collaborating closely with a diverse array of talented individuals who share a deep passion for innovation.Your primary focus will involve tackling intricate business challenges in tandem with Sales Leadership, Finance, Growth, GTM, Operations, and other essential stakeholders, fostering seamless synergy and driving impactful outcomes.

We are seeking  a highly skilled Sales Revenue Analyst to join our team in Boston, MA or New York, NY. Your role will involve providing critical support and vision to our revenue team by overseeing the meticulous calculation of global sales team commissions and accurate recognition of new business revenue as we strategically expand into new markets and drive revenue growth.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

• Spearhead the strategic ownership, iterative refinement, and optimization of monthly commission strategies across diverse verticals, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and driving performance excellence from our Go-to-Market motion

• Lead the conceptualization and execution of innovative, cross-functional solutions aimed at scaling Sales Revenue operations to new heights of efficiency and effectiveness

• Collaborate on the customization of analytical frameworks to evaluate the business impact of existing incentive-based compensation plans, delivering actionable insights to enhance refinement and improvement efforts

• Conduct comprehensive analysis of the Deal Close process to ensure the efficacy and soundness of new commercial sales. Meticulously review deal structures, financial terms, and product pricing with precision

• Establish and maintain a robust reporting infrastructure for core sales processes, encompassing quota allocation, compensation plans, coverage and territory management, and real-time performance monitoring to drive informed decision-making.

• Partner with Strategy and Growth teams in the development of scalable sales compensation structures and initiatives, fostering alignment with board-level growth objectives

• Grow your technical and functional expertise in Salesforce and auxiliary SaaS systems including: Tableau, CaptivateIQ, Jira, Clari, Confluence

• 2-4 years of experience in revenue, sales operations, FP&A, business analyst or consulting roles demonstrating a solid foundation in finance and business principles

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, coupled with the ability to swiftly establish trust, credibility, and influence across diverse stakeholders

• Familiarity with Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) business models, showcasing an understanding of recurring revenue dynamics and subscription-based businesses

• Demonstrated ability to think strategically about complex issues, showcasing adept problem-solving skills and analytical prowess

• Excellent interpersonal skills, with a track record of effectively presenting to teams of diverse functions and hierarchical levels, fostering collaboration and understanding

Bonus Points:

• Prior experience in a high-growth SaaS company and/or multi-national public company,demonstrating adaptability and ability to thrive in dynamic environments

• Familiarity with SaaS company economics, deal structuring, and revenue models, indicating a comprehensive understanding of subscription-based business models.

• Experience working in Mac OS

• Familiarity with Tableau, Metabase, and (or) other business intelligence systems

• Experience with advanced analytics to deliver forecasts and/or intuitive models

• Previous experience in client-facing role or working with C-suite executives

jobs.title: Customer Support Specialist - English (Morning/Afternoon)
jobs.description:
At Mudflap, we're modernizing the $1 trillion trucking industry, the backbone of the U.S. economy. By helping over 100,000 underserved small businesses save over $1 billion on fuel, Mudflap has quickly grown into a profitable fintech platform that processes billions in annual payment volume.



Join the team powering the backbone of America



Mudflap is a fast-growing marketplace on a mission to support the independent truckers who keep our country moving. Our Customer Support team sits at the heart of that mission, available 24/7/365 to show up when it matters most.



We’re looking for a passionate, people-focused individual to join this essential team. At Mudflap, customer obsession is a core value, and customer support is one of THE most important roles at the company. Our close-knit, mission-driven team thrives on solving problems, driving growth, and helping our customers succeed.



We don’t just provide support, we fuel success.



Current shift times available, all ET:

 - Monday - Thursday: 10:00 AM - 8:00 PM

 - Monday - Friday: 4:00 AM -12:00 PM

 - Saturday - Wednesday: 5:00 AM - 1:00 PM
   

Work Location: Remote



To support our team, we offer:

 - Commuter benefits to ease your travel

 - Lunches and snacks to keep you fueled

 - A collaborative, high-growth environment where you’ll work closely with talented teammates across the company



Expectations (In this role, you will):

We hold a high bar for customer support and we’re proud of it.

Here’s what success looks like in this role:

 - Strong Phone Presence: You communicate clearly and confidently, with a warm, professional tone and genuine empathy

 - Real-Time Problem Solving: You think fast on your feet, troubleshoot effectively, and keep customers reassured every step of the way

 - Comfortable with High Volume: You thrive in a high-call environment and know how to stay sharp, organized, and efficient throughout the day

 - Customer-Obsessed: You go above and beyond to deliver an experience that feels effortless, personal, and thoughtful

 - Emotionally Intelligent: You can read between the lines, pick up on customer signals, and respond in creative, thoughtful ways that show deep understanding

 - Ambitious and Growth-Oriented: You’re hungry to learn, open to feedback, and excited to grow your skills and career with Mudflap

 - Tech-Savvy: You move comfortably between tools like Zendesk, Slack, and internal systems without skipping a beat



Experience (What we look for):

 - 2+ years of experience in a remote customer support role, ideally in fintech or tech startup environments

 - Proficient with support tools like Zendesk or similar ticketing systems

 - Customer-first mindset with a genuine passion for delivering exceptional service

 - Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written

 - Thrives in fast-paced environment, you’re a strong multitasker with a high sense of urgency and a hands-on, team-oriented approach



Perks and Benefits (What we offer): 

 - Competitive pay and equity in a high-growth startup

 - Multiple health benefit options

 - Paid Time Off

 - 401(k) matching

 - Opportunities and support for major career growth

 - Annual Company offsite event (Mudfest!)



The pay range for this role is $23 - $27 per hour. This information reflects a base range for this position based on current market data, which may be subject to change as new market data becomes available. The candidate's skills, experience, and other relevant factors will determine the exact compensation. 



We’ve got you covered! Training runs for three weeks, and we’ll ship you the equipment you need to succeed.



Company overview (Who we are):

Mudflap is on a mission to transform the trucking and logistics industry by leveling the playing field for owner operators and small fleets. Backed by top-tier venture investors, including QED, Matrix Partners, Commerce Ventures, NFX, and 500 Startups and included in the Forbes Fintech 50 list, Mudflap offers fleet fuel management solutions. Our core team hails from Disney, Uber, Procore, DoorDash, Google, Meta, Capital One, Affirm and Brex.

Here are the core values that we believe in and look for in new teammates:

 - Be Customer Obsessed: We deeply understand customer needs and put our customers at the center of everything we do

 - Make it Count: Act like an owner by focusing on the impact of your work

 - Find a Way: Be a creative problem solver who pushes past roadblocks to win for our customers and our teammates

 - Sweat the Details: We keep our standards high and achieve them by paying attention to every detail

 - Be Curious: Use a growth mindset to question assumptions, take calculated risks and stretch the boundaries of what’s possible



*If your application is selected for the next stage, you will receive an email invite to complete a short take-home assessment through our assessment platform, TestGorilla. This helps us better understand your skills and how you approach tasks relevant to the role. Please check both your inbox and spam folder for the email invite, and please complete the assessment as soon as possible. Thank you!

jobs.title: Senior Agency Development Manager
jobs.description:
StackAdapt is the leading technology company that empowers marketers to reach, engage, and convert audiences with precision. With 465 billion automated optimizations per second, the AI-powered StackAdapt Marketing Platform seamlessly connects brand and performance marketing to drive measurable results across the entire customer journey. The most forward-thinking marketers choose StackAdapt to orchestrate high-impact campaigns across programmatic advertising and marketing channels.

StackAdapt is seeking a Senior Agency Development Manager to accelerate platform adoption and commercial growth across Publicis, WPP, and Havas in the United States.

This role will serve as the primary strategy and activation partner for Programmatic Centers of Excellence and centralized programmatic teams across these Holding Companies. The Senior Agency Development Manager will translate enterprise-level partnerships into scalable onboarding, education, certification, and product-adoption programs that enable agency practitioners to confidently recommend and activate StackAdapt.

Working closely with StackAdapt’s Sales, Account Management, Product, Solutions, and Marketing teams, this person will identify and remove barriers to adoption, support nuanced platform and product questions, and help convert Holding Company partnerships into measurable campaign activity and platform spend.

StackAdapt is a remote-first company; however, for this position, we are prioritizing candidates based in New York or Chicago due to their proximity to key agency partners.

What You'll Be Doing:

HoldCo Activation & COE Partnership

• Translate Holding Company agreements and strategic priorities into actionable activation frameworks tailored to the operating models of Publicis, WPP, and Havas.

• Develop and execute scalable activation programs for Programmatic COEs, including strategic onboarding, certifications, workshops, and custom training programs.

• Partner with COEs and support the Director of Agency Development to execute joint business plans, ensuring StackAdapt is effectively positioned.

• Equip COE leaders and practitioners with the knowledge and materials needed to confidently advocate for and activate StackAdapt.

• Measure the success of these programs by tracking participation, platform usage, and resulting campaign activation.

Platform Expertise & Programmatic Media Strategy

• Serve as the primary programmatic resource, helping agency teams translate complex platform capabilities into clear use cases, internal guidance, and actionable workflows.

• Proactively identify technical, educational, or commercial barriers preventing activation, and coordinate the appropriate internal resources to resolve them.

Sales Partnership & Opportunity Development

• Act as the connective tissue between agency COEs and StackAdapt’s Sales and Account Management teams, ensuring clear ownership of brand engagement.

• Provide sellers with agency intelligence and platform expertise to help them advance opportunities more effectively.

• Leverage COE insights to identify under-penetrated areas and support campaign development, without replacing the seller as the owner of the commercial process.

Cross-Functional Strategy & Market Insights

• Capture recurring agency feedback, workflow trends, and competitive insights, translating them into actionable guidance for Product, Marketing, and leadership.

• Identify strategic opportunities for custom adoption initiatives, co-development, beta participation, and specialized agency programming.

What You'll Bring to the Table

• 5+ years in digital advertising, programmatic media, or ad-tech, with experience in agency development, client activation, solutions, or platform adoption.

• Direct experience working with major agency Holding Companies, ideally Publicis, WPP, or Havas, and a strong understanding of Programmatic COEs.

• Deep knowledge of programmatic advertising, including DSPs, audiences, measurement, optimization, and campaign workflows.

• Proven ability to build relationships with senior agency stakeholders and influence adoption across complex organizations.

• Strategic mindset with experience connecting platform adoption and client engagement to campaign activity, pipeline, and revenue growth.

• Strong communicator who can turn complex product concepts into practical, client-facing recommendations.

• Commercially minded, highly organized, and comfortable working cross-functionally in a remote-first environment, with a willingness to travel as needed.

jobs.title: Alternative Delivery Market Lead (Water, Civil/Linear, Federal)
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking an Alternative Delivery Market Lead to join our Austin, TX, Dallas, TX, or Denver, Colorado office.

Our Alternative Delivery Practice connects our Design-Build expertise across services, markets, and geographies to manage outcome-driven projects that deliver social, economic and environmental value. The Practice focuses on the detailed design on these types of projects, with contractors being the primary clientele. The projects stem from programs of critical national importance in water and transportation, including major water/wastewater; transit; aviation; and surface transportation projects shaping many of North America’s major cities.

In line with our growth strategy, we are currently seeking an Alternative Delivery Market Lead, Vice President, to support capturing major new business within our Alternative Delivery Practice.

Due to the nature of this role, the location is flexible, however preference will be given to US based professionals, and can be remote / virtual with travel as and when required.

Reporting to Senior Vice President (SVP), North American Alternative Delivery Market Executive, the successful candidate will direct and support strategic capture management efforts within the North American Alternative Delivery market in partnership with our Global and Regional Business Lines. This candidate will develop and maintain business relationships while identifying client needs to advance AECOM’s growth and profitability in the market. Key requirements of this role include the following:

• Understand the various types of procurement models developing within the North American Alternative Delivery markets across multiple sectors with tasks to develop communication strategies between both agencies, contractor clients, and internal resources related to these models.
• Understand firm-wide capabilities and bring regional and global expertise to pursuits.
• Win major strategic pursuits as the consultative sales process leader, contributing strategy, business development best practices and sales leadership to drive an integrated growth strategy.
• Partner with internal Client Account Managers (CAMs), Marketing and Capture Managers to close new business, drive our sales process, prepare and facilitate presentations, including contributing input to commercial proposals.
• Assist developing and implementing the Business Line Growth Plans. Work with internal Global and Business Line Leaders, Regional Business Line Leaders and Client Account Managers (CAMs) to define growth targets and prioritize pursuits.
• Coordinate with internal Legal and Commercial leadership as the interface with external contractor parters in developing project agreement terms & conditions.
• Support building and maintaining a deep and diversified qualified opportunity pipeline.
• Direct discovery, pre-positioning, differentiation, and delivery strategies for major transformative programs with current/prospective clients and internal partners.
• Bring discipline and rigor to the Go/No Go process and capture management planning phase.
• Work in collaboration with Marketing to develop and execute strategic marketing campaigns that position AECOM around key opportunities.
• Lead pursuit team strategy meetings and coach presentation/interview teams in coordination with Marketing.

Key attributes include:

• External Presence - Has strong market, marketing, and technical knowledge, which is relevant to the opportunity being pursued.
• Internal Presence - Ability to communicate pursuit priorities clearly across market sectors to executive, regional and business line leadership, to ensure resources are made available and win strategies are supported.
• Partnering with Technical and Marketing Staff - Guides technical writers and agency CAMs to develop dynamic and compelling content, that is both compliant and compelling/persuasive. Ensures partnership between technical and marketing staff for proposal best practices.
• Growth - Drives growth through the ability to position for and capture key opportunities including both new business opportunities and the renewal/extension of existing opportunities within the account.
• Impact on AECOM Reputation - Champion for ethical and safe working practices while focusing on ED&I endeavors, striving to align AECOM’s initiatives with those of the client.
• Innovation - Understanding client’s innovation agenda, acts as a conduit to position AECOM’s innovative solutions within the specific opportunity while encouraging adoption of key AECOM initiatives.
• Delivery focus - Demonstrated ability to set a schedule and milestones for the opportunity short-, medium- and long-term goals, including reviews, deliverables, and ultimate delivery of the bid/proposal while managing the opportunity budget.
• Commercial - Demonstrates good understand of commercial elements of contracts (financial/pricing, legal/risk and governance).
• Development of people/ mentoring - Coaches and supports other team members in building strong relationships within the capture team and trains others in AECOM to enhance their capture management skills.
• Displays aspirational leadership behaviors - People/Team Developer - Encourages diverse, accountable, and inclusive teams leveraging AECOM’s global footprint to enable individual growth and collective success through trust, autonomy, accountability, and alignment.

Minimum Requirements

• BA/BS + 12 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education, including 4 years of leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

• The candidate should demonstrate a proven track record of sales production, specifically the winning of major enterprise level pursuits.
• They should also be high energy, outgoing and self-motivated with a track record of winning major pursuits, capturing new business, and driving integrated multidiscipline teams through a consultative sales process with Major and/or Global clients.
• Professional Engineer license or equivalent type of experience working in a contracting environment.
• Experience must demonstrate sales production metrics, demonstrated skills in business development strategy, team leadership, client discovery and development of compelling value propositions that meet client’s needs.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. jobs.title: Commercial Partnerships & Operations Director
jobs.description:
At Counterpart Health (CPH), we are transforming healthcare and improving patient care with our innovative primary care tool, Counterpart Assistant (CA). By supporting Primary Care Physicians (PCPs), we are able to deliver improved outcomes to patients at a lower cost through early diagnosis and longitudinal care management of chronic conditions.

We're seeking a Commercial Partnerships & Operations Director to shape and drive key commercial initiatives and strategic partnerships. Reporting to the VP of Commercial Innovations & Partnerships, you'll partner closely with CPH leadership, owning a portfolio of high-impact initiatives and external partnerships.

This role is a senior individual contributor who is a highly organized, analytical, and execution-focused operator who can move fluidly between the details of execution and the strategic context, bringing forward recommendations and insights that shape leadership decisions. You'll lead cross-functional programs, keep priorities on track, align stakeholders, manage external relationships, and deliver the insights and materials needed to support strategic decisions and accelerate Counterpart Health's growth and execution capabilities.

As a Commercial Partnerships & Operations Director, you will:

• Lead high-priority commercial initiatives: Own the execution of high priority cross-functional programs by defining project plans, tracking milestones, mitigating risks, resolving dependencies, and ensuring timely delivery of strategic outcomes.

• Drive cross-functional execution: Lead efforts across Commercial, Product, Engineering, Clinical, Operations, Legal, and external partners to align stakeholders, maintain momentum, and deliver on commitments.

• Manage strategic partnerships: Own key external partnerships by establishing governance, aligning strategic objectives, driving executive engagement, resolving risks, and ensuring successful execution throughout the partnership lifecycle.

• Deliver business insights: Develop and lead analytical models, dashboards, and performance trackers to monitor results, generate insights, and inform commercial decision-making.

• Prepare executive communications: Develop executive-level presentations, reports, and recommendations that frame strategic options, clarify tradeoffs, and guide decisions by leadership and external partners.

• Strengthen program execution: Translate enterprise commercial priorities into actionable plans with defined owners, timelines, deliverables, and accountability while proactively identifying and resolving execution risks.

• Enhance operational effectiveness: Design and implement scalable processes, tools, templates, and reporting mechanisms that improve coordination, visibility, and execution across the Commercial Innovations & Partnerships team.

• Serve as a trusted operator: Serve as a trusted commercial advisor by anticipating enterprise risks, challenging assumptions, recommending solutions, and maintaining alignment across multiple high-stakes initiatives.

Success in this Role Looks Like:

• In the first 90 days: Build a strong understanding of CPH's commercial strategy, products, partnerships, and operating model. Establish relationships across internal teams and external partners. Take ownership of key initiatives and establish greater strategic clarity, accountability, visibility, and execution discipline.

• In the first 6 months: Independently own a portfolio of commercial initiatives and strategic partnership workstreams. Implement effective project management processes and reporting frameworks.Deliver high-quality analyses and recommendations that influence executive decision-making and drive progress.

• At the end of your first year: Become a trusted execution partner to the VP of Commercial Innovations & Partnerships and the CPH leadership team. Successfully lead multiple complex initiatives from planning through execution.Strengthen partnership performance, enhance cross-functional execution, and scale the Commercial Innovations & Partnerships function.

You should get in touch if:

• 6–10 years of experience in healthcare consulting, a healthcare technology company, or a similar execution-focused role in a high-growth healthcare organization.

• Strong preference for candidates with experience in Medicare, Medicare Advantage, value-based care, payer-provider dynamics, healthcare operations, and roles such as business operations, program management, partnerships, or cross-functional execution.

• Proven ability to manage complex, cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and competing priorities; experience in a Project Management Office (PMO) or dedicated program management role is a plus.

• Exceptional organizational and project management skills, with a track record of bringing structure, accountability, and execution to complex initiatives.

• Experience managing external partner or customer relationships, including coordinating meetings, driving follow-ups, and ensuring successful execution.

• Strong analytical skills with advanced proficiency in AI tools, Excel, and Google Sheets, including experience building financial models, dashboards, trackers, and other reporting tools.

• Excellent written and visual communication skills, with the ability to create executive-ready presentations and synthesize complex information into clear, actionable insights.

• Strong knowledge of Medicare and Medicare Advantage, value-based care, healthcare operations, and payer-provider dynamics.

• Ability to thrive in fast-paced environments, manage multiple priorities, and adapt to changing business needs while maintaining a high standard of quality.

• Demonstrated ability to influence and drive results through strong organization, collaboration, communication, and execution rather than formal authority.

Benefits Overview:

• Financial Well-Being: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.

• Physical Well-Being: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare.

• Mental Well-Being: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.

• Professional Development: Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

Additional Perks:

• Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities

• Reimbursement for office setup expenses

• Monthly cell phone & internet stipend

• Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams

• Paid parental leave for all new parents

• And much more!

About Counterpart Health: In 2018, Clover Health set out to do something unprecedented: build a clinically intuitive, AI-enabled solution that fits within physicians' workflows to help support the earlier diagnosis and management of chronic conditions.

Years later, that vision is a reality, with thousands of practitioners using Counterpart Assistant during patient visits to improve disease management, reduce medical expenses, and drive success in value-based care.

With an exceptional team of value-based care and technology experts, Counterpart Health is driving value-based care at the speed of software.

Counterpart Health is a subsidiary of Clover Health. From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

We have rapidly grown to over $1 billion in annual revenue and we’re just getting started!

As a Customer Service Associate at Zoro, you will play a crucial role in delivering exceptional service to our customers by promptly and accurately resolving their inquiries or issues. Your primary objective will be to deepen the relationship with Zoro customers and drive loyalty and sales by providing a seamless and satisfactory customer experience through efficient communication and problem-solving skills. • Order Processing: Assist customers with placing orders, tracking shipments, processing returns, and managing account information.

• Resource Knowledge: Develop a comprehensive understanding of our process resources, products, and services to effectively address customer questions in order to provide the correct information.

• Strong problem-solving, critical thinking and decision-making skills, with the ability to think quickly.

• Ability to use various information sources to answer questions, identify problems and appropriately resolve customer issues.

Total Rewards

At Zoro, we’re growing fast toward big aspirations — and we’re continuously excited about the new challenges we get to solve together.

This role manages day-to-day technical support, reliability improvement, root cause analysis, operational readiness, and performance optimization for solar and storage facilities across the operating fleet.

The manager provides technical leadership for solar modules, inverters, trackers, and battery energy management systems. The role also develops engineering standards, strengthens technical knowledge management, reviews new project construction and acquisitions, and mentors engineers and technical contributors to assure safe, reliable, efficient, and cost-effective operation.

Our Scottsdale office is the preferred location for this hybrid position. If you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications but see yourself contributing, please submit your resume

What You'll Be Doing

Fleet Technical Leadership

• Lead Operations Engineering support for Solar PV and BESS throughout the Clearway operating fleet.

• Direct reliability improvements, corrective action development, and root cause analysis for Solar and BESS systems.

• Oversee systems testing (Capacity, Round-Trip Efficiency, etc) to ensure plants meet offtake requirements.

• Recommend, prioritize, and drive solutions that maximize reliability, availability, production, safety, and lifecycle value of Solar and BESS equipment.

• Provide technical leadership for solar modules, inverters, trackers, BESS controls, and battery energy management systems.

• Partner with O&M, Asset Management, Performance Analytics, Real-time Performance Monitoring Center, NERC/Compliance, Construction, Procurement, Warranty, Insurance, and external vendors to resolve issues and implement fleetwide lessons learned.

Engineering Standards, Programs, and Knowledge Management

• Develop, maintain, and improve internal Solar/BESS technical specifications, operational procedures, testing and operational readiness checklists, lessons-learned, and engineering knowledge databases.

• Establish consistent practices for solar module performance analysis, inverter issue resolution, BESS capacity test support, battery augmentation planning, equipment obsolescence reviews, and repowering evaluations.

• Review drawings, single-line diagrams, site layouts, technical manuals, test reports, and vendor documentation to support safe and effective operations.

• Support training programs for site personnel and internal stakeholders by translating technical findings into practical inspection, maintenance, troubleshooting, and operating guidance.

Project, Vendor, and Lifecycle Support

• Support new project construction and acquisition integration by identifying technical risks and gaps and ensuring preparedness for turnover to operations.

• Provide technical support for warranties, insurance claims, vendor performance discussions, equipment replacements, product issues, and corrective action plans.

• Manage technical workstreams, cross-functional action plans, consultant scopes, and vendor deliverables related to Solar and BESS reliability, performance, and lifecycle management.

• Assess equipment obsolescence, repowering, augmentation, retrofit, and performance-improvement opportunities for existing solar and storage plants.

People Leadership and Team Development

• Manage, coach, and develop Solar/BESS engineering staff and technical contributors, including goal setting, prioritization, work planning, technical review, and professional development.

• Balance urgent fleet support with longer-term reliability, standards, documentation, and improvement initiatives.

• Promote a strong safety culture, disciplined technical decision-making, clear communication, and practical engineering solutions that support operational excellence.

What You'll Bring

• B.S. in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, Energy Systems, Engineering Technology, or a related engineering field.

• 7+ years of experience related to renewable energy, energy storage, power distribution, power systems, plant operations, equipment reliability, or related industry experience.

• Prior experience leading engineers, managing technical programs, or coordinating cross-functional technical workstreams.

• Demonstrated ability to identify and implement detailed solutions to complex technical problems and to convert lessons learned into practical standards and fleet procedures.

• Excellent written and oral communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with site teams, executives, internal stakeholders, customers, owners, contractors, consultants, OEMs, integrators, and external partners.

• Advanced knowledge of Solar PV and BESS operation, maintenance, controls, performance, and reliability requirements.

• Experienced understanding of electrical power generation, plant operations, maintenance practices, inverter systems, BESS controls, and hybrid ESS + PV configurations.

• Able to read and interpret electrical drawings, technical manuals, test reports, control diagrams, communication drawings, and plant layouts.

• Knowledgeable in real and reactive power support and load flow analysis.

• Knowledgeable in applicable technical standards, including UL1703, UL1741, UL9540, UL9540A, NFPA 68, NFPA 69, NFPA 70, NFPA 72, and NFPA 855.

• Must successfully function as both a technical leader and a member of a cross-functional team.

• Must be able to maintain a professional and positive company image and constructive relationships with owners, customers, internal contractors, and external contractors.

• Must be able to communicate clearly, prioritize effectively, and drive closure on technical issues with appropriate urgency and documentation discipline.

• May be required to work flexible hours at times to support fleet events or urgent operational issues.

• Position is located in Scottsdale, Arizona, where several Operations Engineers, the Real-time Performance Monitoring Center, Procurement, and Construction are prevalent.

• Ability to travel up to 40%.

What Would Be Nice

• Advanced degree or professional engineering credentials are preferred.

• Working familiarity with software tools such as ETAP, PSCAD, LabVIEW, or similar platforms is a bonus.

Clearway will not sponsor non-immigrant visas for this position (H-1B, TN, E-3, etc.).

#LI-Hybrid

This role is eligible to earn an annual cash bonus, subject to personal and company performance goals.

jobs.title: Starlink Enterprise Account Manager, Latin America
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

STARLINK ENTERPRISE ACCOUNT MANAGER, LATIN AMERICA

Starlink, our revolutionary satellite constellation, is delivering low-latency broadband internet around the world. The Starlink Enterprise Account Management team serves as the point of contact for Starlink’s growing base of enterprise customers from contract signature, through successful activation, ensuring all contract terms are fulfilled. Our ideal candidate is a self-starter who has a passion for making customers deliriously happy and connecting enterprises with Starlink.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Act as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of enterprise customers, owning the interface from contract signature onwards including onboarding, ongoing account management, and long-term retention/growth of the relationship and revenue with emphasis on: Supporting, closely managing, and learning from the direct customers that require unique Starlink products to meet their industry needs (i.e. primary connectivity, secondary connectivity, trucking, oil and gas, etc.)

• Defining, standardizing, and streamlining processes, enabling these custom solutions to scale across the business

• Delivering impeccable customer service, including efficient acknowledgment and resolution of issues

• Building relationships to identify requirements and manage expectations

• Collecting, communicating and championing customer feedback internally to influence and steer programmatic and technical development required to maintain and grow the enterprise business

• Retaining and growing the value of accounts in both hardware and service revenue

• Act as an extreme owner of assigned accounts to realize forecasted revenue on or ahead of schedule, identifying and successfully communicating readiness levels, requirements, schedules and risks

• Identify and lead implementation of process and system enhancements to improve handoffs and execution across various cross-functional teams, evolve the customer experience, or scale the business while balancing resources and headcount

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree; OR high school diploma/equivalency certificate and 10+ years of professional business development, operations, engineering, or account management experience

• 3+ years of consulting or project management experience

• 3+ year experience in a customer-facing role

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Significant knowledge, experience, or interest in specific customer industries like (i.e. maritime, rail, trucking, agriculture, cellular backhaul, or satellite communications)

• Experience managing multiple projects and delivering under tight time and resource constraints

• Excellent problem-solving and sleuthing skills, going beyond just the apparent and available answer

• Significant technical knowledge of Starlink or telecommunications in at least one key area (e.g. satellites, ground network, user terminals, etc.)

• Demonstrated ability to turn customer feedback into actionable, smart improvements

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including ability to craft and present professional presentations

• Excellent empathy, active listening, and resiliency skills

• Ability to read contract documents and discern requirements and deliverables

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Must be available to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed to support critical milestones or operations shifts

• Availability and willingness to travel up to 15% of the time as needed to customer sites/meetings

• This is NOT a remote position and would require relocation if not local to the Hawthorne, CA area

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 3: $115,000.00 - $180,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. jobs.title: Family Law Paralegal - Virginia Beach, VA
jobs.description:
Cordell & Cordell has the benefits you'd expect from a large national firm. We offer competitive compensation, exceptional health care benefits, and prioritize work-life balance to ensure the well-being and productivity of our employees. Our focus on family law allows us to make a meaningful impact by helping families navigate challenging and pivotal times in their lives.

Job Title: Family Law Paralegal

Location: Virginia Beach, VA

Cordell & Cordell has the benefits you'd expect from a large national firm. We offer competitive compensation, exceptional health care benefits, and prioritize work-life balance to ensure the well-being and productivity of our employees. Our team of experienced family law attorneys and legal professionals is committed to providing exceptional service to our clients during critical moments in their lives.

What You’ll Do

• Draft pleadings, motions, discovery requests/responses, and other legal documents.

• Prepare documentation such as financial disclosures, child support worksheets, and parenting plans.

• Manage case calendars, track deadlines, and ensure timely filings.

• Communicate with clients, courts, and opposing counsel in a professional manner.

• Edit draft documents for client changes and prepare documents for signing.

• Handle sensitive client data with utmost discretion, care, and accuracy.

• Perform tasks as assigned with accuracy and promptness, meeting all agreed-upon deadlines.

Who You Are
We’re looking for someone who brings a blend of professionalism, reliability, and a commitment to quality client service. Ideal candidates will possess:

• Must have a minimum of 3+ years of family law paralegal or legal assistant experience

• Associate’s degree in paralegal studies or equivalent

• Excellent typing skills and computer literacy, including a solid understanding Microsoft Word, Outlook, Excel

• Proficiency with legal software and case management systems (e.g., Smart Advocate, Clio, MyCase, or similar).

• Demonstrate proficiency to focus on details, handle multiple tasks, and remain highly organized

• Strong verbal and written communication skills, with a collaborative and approachable demeanor

• A professional presence and the ability to interact confidently with clients and colleagues

• Reliable transportation and the ability to be onsite Monday through Friday from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM

• A proactive mindset and willingness to go above and beyond on simple requests to make things easier for others

Why this Role Matters

As a Family Law Paralegal, you play a pivotal role in one of the most emotionally sensitive and impactful areas of legal practice. Your work ensures that each client feels supported, informed, and empowered during life-changing events like divorce, custody disputes, and child support matters. By providing critical case management, document preparation, and compassionate communication, you help streamline complex legal processes and uphold the integrity of our client experience. Your attention to detail and empathy directly impact the lives of families — making this role essential to both our clients’ outcomes and Cordell & Cordell’s reputation for excellence in domestic litigation.

Cordell & Cordell provides exceptional benefits and a great working environment including:
We also offer our full-time employees the following benefits:

• Medical Plans: including HDHP, PPO, HSA and FSA

• Dental, Vision, Life and AD&D, Long-Term Disability, and Short-Term Disability Insurance

• 401(k) Savings with Employer Matching

• Paid time off

• Participate in our Wellness Program and potentially earn Employer Paid health premiums!

For more information: https://cordellcordell.com/about/careers/benefits/

jobs.title: Client Service Rep-Personal Lines
jobs.description:
We are W3 an IMA Company, an independent insurance agency founded in 1925. We have a rich history of providing quality service and unwavering commitment to our clients and community. Our agency represents an extensive list of "A rated" insurance companies to provide the best coverage, at the most affordable rates available.  We have insurance products to fit the specific needs of both businesses and individual, offering commercial, homeowners, auto, boat and life insurance.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting the advisors in the client service aspect of managing a personal lines book of business as assigned, and consistently provide excellent customer service and leadership to accounts, as well as represent client needs and goals within the organization to ensure quality by performing the following duties:

JOB DUTIES:

• Work collaboratively and cooperatively with others, with a commitment to a workplace of dignity and respect, in compliance with equal employment opportunity standards and regulations.

• Accept coaching from supervisors and managers, in compliance with the Agency's policies and procedures.

• Take and process premium payments from clients.

• Rate policies and be familiar with carrier underwriting guidelines (marketing, quoting, binding of personal insurance products).

• Check new and renewal policies for accuracy in rating, typing, coverage, signatures. Ensure that these items are delivered and/or mailed to client.

• Receive phone calls from clients and companies regarding insurance, claims, or administrative problems, and comply with the request.

• Analyze policy transactions and correct company records to adjust errors.

• Interpret policy provisions to determine methods of effecting desired changes, type of insurance, or change in method of payment.

• Input customer applications into the agency management system from the carrier rating applications.

• Assist Personal Insurance Advisors with all customer service responsibilities.

• Update computer for cancellations, reinstatements. Send out form letter to clients as applicable.

• Provide superior customer service to clients.

• Report issues and follow up for resolutions with carriers and clients.

• Assist in completion of Underwriting audits as required.

• Assist in data entry, projects, creating client portfolios as similar tasks.

• Handle routine correspondence between carriers, agency and insured.

• Maintain a working knowledge of the insurance marketplace, including specific coverage and industry targets.

• Maintain electronic files in an orderly, up-to-date manner and with our current status guidelines.

• Monitor personal continuing education requirements to ensure compliance with licensing requirements. Attend classes as necessary.

• Provide backup support to the CSR team and Advisors.

• Become familiar with and follow Agency guidelines, policies and procedures.

This is not an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities. Other duties and responsibilities may be assigned, based on Agency needs.

REQUIRED EDUCATION & QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

• Florida 4-40 or 2-20 License Required

• High School Diploma/GED Required

• 3 or more years experience in personal lines insurance

• Solid understanding of all lines of Florida Personal insurance

• Ability to build rapport with each customer through active listening

• Experience dealing the multiple insurance carriers

• Knowledge of Applied "EPIC" Agency Management System beneficial

• Proficient with Microsoft Word and Excel

Compensation & Benefits

Being a part of IMA has its benefits. When you become part of the IMA family, you become eligible to take part in our valuable benefits and rewards package designed to benefit you, your family, and your life. Our plans are cost-effective, convenient and provide progressive ways for staying healthy, protecting loved ones, pursuing financial security and living a full and balanced life. This role is eligible for the following:

Annual Performance Bonus, Stock Purchase, Medical Plans, Prescription Drugs, Dental, Vision, Family Assistance Program, FSA, HSA, Pre-Tax Parking Plan, 401(k), Life/AD&D, Accident, Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, Long Term Care, Short-term Disability, Long-term Disability, Business Travel Accident, Identity Theft, Paid Time Off, Flexible Work Options, Paid Holidays, Sabbatical, Gift Matching, Well-Being Stipend, Personal and Professional Development.  In addition to our robust benefits package, the final offer amounts will depend on a variety of factors, including the candidate’s geographic location, prior relevant experience, and their knowledge, skills, and abilities.

*These benefits do not apply to internship roles.

Why Join IMA?

We’ve built a reputation for putting our associates first

What if we told you that you could be an integral part of an entrepreneurial, expanding company, develop lasting relationships, earn competitive benefits, plus claim part ownership? It’s this unique ownership business model that makes working at IMA so appealing.

We work in teams. We sell in teams. We win and prosper as a team

We provide support systems and resources that enable each of our associates to focus on what they do best. And as an independent company based in the Midwest, we’re big enough to write business all over the world and small enough to implement your ideas quickly.

We are recognized nationally as a leader in our industry

• 2020-2023 Business Insurance Magazine Best Places to Work in Insurance

• 2023 Inc. Magazine’s Best Workplaces

• 2023 Denver Business Journal’s Best Places to Work

• 2022-2023 Connecticut Top Work Places
