jobs.title: VP, Product & Design
jobs.description:
The VP (Vice President), Product & Design will lead product experience and roadmap development across the NFL’s portfolio of digital products and platforms, translating vision and strategy into scalable execution. As a key member of the Global Digital Fan Engagement leadership team, this executive will lead Product and Design functions responsible for creating world-class fan experiences across web, mobile, connected television (CTV), identity, subscription, and viewing platforms.

Working in close partnership with Strategy & Growth, Technology, Content, Marketing, Business Operations, and other key departments across the NFL, the VP, Product & Design will translate business priorities into product roadmaps and deliver experiences that deepen fan engagement, improve experience quality, and support the NFL's long-term strategic priorities.

This role requires an experienced and dynamic product executive capable of leading organizational evolution, establishing product management excellence, and building a high-performing team within a complex and highly visible media ecosystem.

Responsibilities:

Product Vision & Roadmap Leadership

• Own the product roadmap for the NFL’s fan-facing product portfolio across web, app, CTV, identity, and subscription experiences

• Partner with Strategy & Growth to translate enterprise priorities and agreed business objectives into product roadmap decisions, prioritization, sequencing, and execution plans

• Lead short-term, seasonal, and multi-year product roadmap planning and sequencing, aligned to the broader long-range business plan and agreed investment priorities

• Establish product management practices that improve prioritization, execution quality, and organizational alignment

Product Delivery & Performance

• Hold end-to-end accountability for product roadmap execution, sequencing, delivery excellence, experience quality, product operating cadence, and post-launch value optimization across the digital portfolio

• Translate agreed strategic priorities into delivered product outcomes that support business goals

• Partner with Strategy & Growth to define KPI frameworks, measurement processes, and post-launch evaluation methodologies

• Drive a culture of continuous improvement through experimentation, learning, and iteration

Fan Experience & Design Leadership

• Lead the Product and Design organizations responsible for creating engaging and intuitive fan experiences

• Establish experience standards and design principles across content discovery, viewing, personalization, subscription, and engagement journeys

• Ensure consistency and quality across all fan-facing experiences

Cross-Functional Leadership

• Partner with Technology to align product roadmaps with technical feasibility, platform architecture, capacity management, and release planning

• Partner with Strategy & Growth to translate agreed business objectives, priority fan segments, value propositions, and desired outcomes into product experiences

• Partner with Content and Marketing to ensure product experiences, content value, and marketing execution reinforce the broader strategy

• Build strong executive partnerships that improve decision making and organizational coordination

• Communicate tradeoffs, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to senior leadership

Organizational Leadership

• Lead and develop a high-performing Product and Design organization

• Build team capabilities through coaching, succession planning, and talent development

• Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and product excellence

Required Qualifications:

• 15+ years of product management experience, including leadership roles in digital media, streaming, sports, technology, or subscription-based businesses

• Experience leading product organizations responsible for large-scale consumer digital platforms

• Demonstrated success delivering complex product roadmaps that drive measurable business outcomes

• Experience leading cross-functional teams within highly matrixed environments

• Strong understanding of digital consumer experiences, content ecosystems, subscription products, and engagement platforms

• Experience leading Product, UX/UI, Design, or adjacent digital experience functions

Leadership Profile:

• Proven track record collaboratively shaping and delivering product roadmaps that drive business outcomes across large-scale consumer digital platforms

• Demonstrated success delivering product roadmaps that support acquisition, engagement, retention, and monetization objectives within DTC or subscription-led businesses

• Strong commercial acumen with the ability to collaborate effectively with Strategy leaders on revenue, customer value, and growth opportunities

• Strong experience operating in complex organizations and aligning cross-functional teams to deliver solutions that meet both business objectives and fan needs

• Executive communicator capable of translating priorities, risks, tradeoffs, and performance into clear narratives tied to business goals

• Strong product judgment, creative instincts, and operational discipline, with a passion for delivering exceptional consumer experiences

Travel:

This position will require travel to key NFL meetings and events, including occasional nights and weekends, especially during the NFL season.

Terms/Expected Hours of Work:

NFL employees are required to work a minimum of 40 hours per week in the office.

Salary / Pay Range:

This job posting contains a pay range, which represents the range of salaries or hourly rates that the NFL believes, in good faith, at the time of this posting that it might be willing to pay for the posted job in the location(s) specified. The NFL expects to hire for this position near the middle of the range. Only in truly rare and exceptional circumstances, where an external candidate has experience, credentials, or expertise that far exceed those required or expected for the position, would the NFL consider paying a salary or rate near the higher end of the range.

Salary

$225,000—$325,000 USD

Benefits Information
To learn more about our comprehensive benefits offerings, please visit: NFL BENEFITS

At the NFL, in-person work at our offices is a top priority because it allows us to collaborate more effectively, build stronger connections, and maintain the culture that drives our success. This role requires onsite presence at an NFL office or stadium location, and remote and/or hybrid working options are not offered.

NO RELOCATION ASSISTANCE WILL BE PROVIDED.

The NFL is committed to building an inclusive work environment that reflects our incredible fan base. We provide an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all employees and applicants without regard to status as protected by applicable federal, state, and local laws.

WHO WE ARE:

NFL Core Values:

• Respect: Everyone matters. We celebrate diverse opinions, honor hard work, and value every contribution.

• Integrity: We do what's right, even when it's tough. We hold ourselves accountable and always follow through.

• Team Responsibility: We support each other and our communities. No one is bigger than the game, and every action impacts others.

• Resiliency: We set high standards, overcome adversity, and adapt to challenges, always striving for excellence.

NFL Leadership Attributes:

• Build Talent: We develop and nurture potential, empowering individuals to grow and succeed.

• Execute: We take action with precision, delivering results that drive our goals forward.

• Inspire: We motivate others through vision, energy, and a commitment to excellence.

• Live Our Values: We embody our core principles in every decision and action.

• Know the Business: We stay informed, understand our industry, and make decisions that strengthen our position.

• Think Big: We challenge the status quo, envision bold possibilities, and strive for transformative impact

WHO YOU ARE:

Talent Attributes:   What we expect for our employees:

• Embody an enthusiastic, proactive can-do attitude

• Embrace grit, free from ego or entitlement

• Excel as a relationship builder, with the ability to influence

• Eager learner, driven by passion rather than just ambition

• Encompasses an incredible work ethic with an agile mindset

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Payments Compliance
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

Airbnb Payments team allows any two people in the world to frictionlessly exchange money with easy to use payments services. It is a core strategy to fulfill Airbnb’s belongs anywhere mission. We are building a world-class payments platform that moves billions of dollars, in 191 countries, with 75 currencies, through a complex ecosystem of payments partners. We build and maintain our own in-house global payments platform because no solution exists with the global reach needed. As the platform grows we’ll be adding new payment partners, global licenses, compliance and regulation controls, and building new payment experiences for our guests and hosts.

Airbnb’s business grows rapidly year over year, and so does Airbnb Payments’ processing volume. Payments Compliance is an essential part of the Payments organization. Without it, Airbnb can be subject to fines and even forbidden from conducting business in certain markets. As a Staff Engineer in the Payments Compliance team, you would drive architectural decisions and implementation for the Compliance systems.

The Difference You Will Make:

We are looking for a self-motivated leader who is interested in working in a highly dynamic environment by collaborating with cross-functional and cross-geographical teams. As a Staff Engineer, you would be expected to bring deep expertise in building and operating large-scale platforms, and support Airbnb’s entire Compliance program and scale it to efficiently adapt to ever evolving regulatory needs. The Payments Compliance systems are complex and interface with various other parts of Airbnb. The systems, APIs, experiences, and tools that you develop will implement controls to make Airbnb compliant with regulations from around the world.

This role centers on the compliance experiences that hosts and guests interact with directly, including the collection and management of the information we are required to obtain. The scope also covers screening of individuals and businesses against global regulatory requirements, and the continuous auditing that verifies our compliance controls are applied as intended. You will set technical direction across all three areas, because they are inseparable in practice: an experience is only as good as the compliance decision behind it, and neither holds up unless we can demonstrate the control was actually enforced.

As a Staff engineer, you’ll be responsible for establishing a technical vision and building alignment within engineering and cross-functional teams, all while delivering a solution that is flexible, always available, efficient, and scales with the needs of the business. Your own unique skill set, rich experiences and thought leadership will be key to success in this role.

A Typical Day:

• Lead the development and refinement of systems powering compliance.

• Partner with technical leaders inside and outside of Compliance to design and build the Compliance systems that are service-oriented, configurable, auditable and efficiently leverage existing Airbnb capabilities.

• Work closely with Product, Design, Policy, Operations and other cross-functional partners as part of a globally distributed team, to define and ship impactful features.

• Partner with other engineering teams in Airbnb to serve our users holistically.

• Lead and mentor engineers, both inside and outside your immediate team, in building solutions and developing skills.

• Advocate for and participate in efforts to advance Airbnb’s engineering processes and technical foundations. Drive systemic improvements by identifying patterns to streamline development, reduce toil and increase technical quality and operational excellence over time.

Your Expertise:

• 9+ years of industry experience in a fast paced tech environment.

• BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience.

• You have excellent communication skills and the ability to work well within a team and with teams across the engineering organization.

• You are a strong problem solver and have led a team that is on-call for production systems before.

• Technical leadership: hands on experience leading project teams and setting technical direction and strategy.

• Nice to have: Prior knowledge of Regulatory Compliance standards and experience in implementing those controls

• Proficiency in one or more back-end server languages (Java/Ruby/Go/C++/etc.)

• Experience with HTML, CSS and modern Javascript frameworks such as React.

• Exposure to architectural patterns of high-scale web and data applications.

• Be future looking - we might be focused on immediate regulations, but need to build for the long term.

• End-to-end ownership mentality that transcends team boundaries.

Your Location:

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list . If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

Pay Range

$212,000—$265,000 USD
